nodes.name: export.go
nodes.summary: CLI export and inspect subcommands: writes a portable .agent-session.zip bundle for one session and prints a validated bundle's summary.

nodes.name: exportCmd
nodes.summary: exportCmd writes a bundle for one session. The catalog is built from a scan of the source provider, since the CLI has no long-lived one.

nodes.name: inspectCmd
nodes.summary: inspectCmd prints a validated bundle's summary.

nodes.name: resolveSession
nodes.summary: resolveSession maps the CLI's agent argument to a provider and a ref.

nodes.name: captureManager
nodes.summary: captureManager builds the read-only capture manager from the default roots. A root that is not configured is simply absent.

nodes.name: exportArgs
nodes.summary: exportArgs splits flags from the positional agent and id, so -o can follow either of them.

nodes.name: main.go
nodes.summary: Entry point of agent-sessions-cli, which inspects local coding-agent sessions without a GUI; dispatches the version, serve, transfer, scan, show, handoff, export, inspect and detect subcommands.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point: resolves the provider set and runs the requested subcommand, exiting with its status.

nodes.name: runWithStdin
nodes.summary: Dispatches the CLI subcommand (version, serve, transfer, scan, show, handoff, export, inspect, detect) with injectable stdio.

nodes.name: usage
nodes.summary: Prints the CLI usage text listing every subcommand and its flags.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Implements the scan subcommand: scans one or all providers and prints sessions as a table or JSON, with optional diagnostics.

nodes.name: printDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Prints one provider's scanner diagnostics to the writer.

nodes.name: show
nodes.summary: Implements the show subcommand: loads one session and prints its metadata or transcript as text or JSON.

nodes.name: showArgs
nodes.summary: showArgs puts options before positionals because flag.Parse stops at the first positional argument, whereas the documented show form puts options last.

nodes.name: printTranscript
nodes.summary: Renders a transcript's messages as readable text, marking compactions and truncating long tool output.

nodes.name: printPart
nodes.summary: Renders one message part (text, reasoning, tool call, attachment) as text with output truncation.

nodes.name: detect
nodes.summary: Implements the detect subcommand: reports which agent providers are installed on this machine.

nodes.name: parseBudget
nodes.summary: Parses a handoff budget flag value (compact, detailed, full, unlimited or a token count).

nodes.name: parseTarget
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the handoff target agent ID.

nodes.name: handoffArgs
nodes.summary: Splits handoff flags from the positional agent and session ID so options may appear anywhere.

nodes.name: handoffCmd
nodes.summary: Implements the handoff subcommand: collects a session tree, builds the handoff document, saves prompt and context files and prints the launch command or JSON.

nodes.name: transfer.go
nodes.summary: CLI transfer subcommand that streams artifacts in (put) or out (get) of a token-named staging file, with token validation, size limits and pruning of stale staging files.

nodes.name: transferCmd
nodes.summary: Implements the transfer subcommand: validates the token and action, then dispatches to get or put on the artifact staging file.

nodes.name: transferPut
nodes.summary: Streams stdin into a staging file bounded by MaxArtifactBytes and reports its SHA-256 for verification.

nodes.name: transferGet
nodes.summary: Streams a staged artifact to stdout, optionally removing it afterwards.

nodes.name: pruneStaging
nodes.summary: Deletes staging files older than maxAge from the transfer directory.

nodes.name: app.go
nodes.summary: Desktop application service bound to the Wails frontend: wires the engine, routes each binding call to the local or remote backend, manages windows and lifecycle, and exposes session, file and update APIs to JS.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: App is the desktop application service bound to the frontend. Every exported method is callable from JS; keep helpers and lifecycle hooks unexported or package-level (see desktop.go).

nodes.name: NewApp
nodes.summary: NewApp creates a new App service instance with default providers.

nodes.name: NewAppWithService
nodes.summary: NewAppWithService wires an App onto an explicit Service instance.

nodes.name: route
nodes.summary: route snapshots where one binding call goes (see connection.route). Take it once per call and use its backend, host and transport together.

nodes.name: localBackend
nodes.summary: Lazily returns the local engine as the Backend used when no remote host is selected.

nodes.name: onStartup
nodes.summary: onStartup starts the local engine and sets up desktop event routing. ctx carries the injected Desktop (see OnStartup).

nodes.name: NewWindow
nodes.summary: NewWindow opens another window of the app, in this process. Each window has an App and a connection of its own, so windows can show different hosts; a host is open in one window at a time (see hostClaims).

nodes.name: ShowAbout
nodes.summary: ShowAbout opens the About window. Windows and Linux reach it from the sidebar's logo; macOS from the app menu.

nodes.name: FocusNextWindow
nodes.summary: FocusNextWindow brings the app's next open window to the front, or the previous one when forward is false, in the order they were opened. With one window open it does nothing.

nodes.name: claimsDir
nodes.summary: claimsDir holds the claims that keep each host open in one window at most; empty without a cache dir.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Scan triggers a scan across all providers and updates the service state.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: close gracefully terminates background scans, watchers, indexers, and the database.

nodes.name: AppVersion
nodes.summary: AppVersion returns this desktop app's version, which is "dev" for builds without the release ldflags. It is local even while connected to a host.

nodes.name: CheckForUpdate
nodes.summary: CheckForUpdate compares this app's version with the latest GitHub release. Like AppVersion it is about this computer's app, whichever host is shown.

nodes.name: Ping
nodes.summary: Ping returns a greeting confirmation from the backend service.

nodes.name: ListGroups
nodes.summary: ListGroups returns the grouped navigation tree for the filtered snapshot.

nodes.name: AgentCounts
nodes.summary: AgentCounts returns per-agent session totals across the filtered catalog.

nodes.name: ListSessions
nodes.summary: ListSessions returns session metadata for one group (or all sessions when groupKey is empty).

nodes.name: GetSessionMeta
nodes.summary: GetSessionMeta returns the catalog metadata for one session.

nodes.name: GetMessages
nodes.summary: GetMessages returns one page of a session transcript.

nodes.name: GetMessagesCapped
nodes.summary: GetMessagesCapped returns one page of a session transcript within the size budget of pc (see engine.PageCap). A remote host too old for the cap returns the whole page.

nodes.name: GetBlob
nodes.summary: GetBlob returns provider-attached content referenced by a message part.

nodes.name: CopyResumeCommand
nodes.summary: CopyResumeCommand builds the provider resume command for a session.

nodes.name: RevealSource
nodes.summary: RevealSource reveals the session's source directory in the system file manager.

nodes.name: ListFiles
nodes.summary: ListFiles lists the files of a session directory on the selected host, for the read-only file viewer.

nodes.name: BlameFile
nodes.summary: BlameFile returns blame for one saved line on the selected host.

nodes.name: ProbeFiles
nodes.summary: ProbeFiles observes saved paths on one captured host route. Consumers must also discard replies from superseded connection/request epochs.

nodes.name: ReadFile
nodes.summary: ReadFile reads one file of a session directory on the selected host.

nodes.name: SaveFile
nodes.summary: SaveFile saves a file edited in the file viewer on the selected host, if it still has the revision it was edited from. host is the host the editor read the file from ("" for Local); the save is refused, with nothing written, when calls are routed elsewhere by now.

nodes.name: ReplaceInFiles
nodes.summary: ReplaceInFiles replaces search matches in files on the selected host. host is the host the search ran on ("" for Local); as with SaveFile, nothing is written when calls are routed elsewhere by now.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Diagnostics returns aggregated scanner health across providers.

nodes.name: OpenURL
nodes.summary: OpenURL validates and opens an external HTTP/HTTPS URL in the default browser.

nodes.name: desktopOpen
nodes.summary: desktopOpen returns the command that opens target, a local directory or an http(s) URL, with the desktop's default handler on goos. On Windows a URL goes to url.dll rather than through cmd.exe, which would interpret & and ^.

nodes.name: terminal.go
nodes.summary: App bindings for choosing the external terminal sessions open in, backed by the local config file, plus helpers resolving the terminal opener for a command.

nodes.name: TerminalOption
nodes.summary: TerminalOption is a terminal app Settings offers.

nodes.name: TerminalSettings
nodes.summary: TerminalSettings is the terminal this computer opens sessions in. It is local: a remote host being selected does not change it.

nodes.name: TerminalSettings
nodes.summary: TerminalSettings lists the installed terminals and the one chosen.

nodes.name: SetTerminal
nodes.summary: SetTerminal chooses the terminal sessions open in: an installed terminal's id, or "" for Automatic.

nodes.name: terminalSettings
nodes.summary: Builds the TerminalSettings view from the detected terminal environment, installed apps and chosen id.

nodes.name: terminalAvailable
nodes.summary: terminalAvailable reports whether Open in terminal can work. A saved choice, even a missing one, or an unreadable config counts: the click then explains what is wrong.

nodes.name: terminalOpener
nodes.summary: terminalOpener resolves what opens a command on this computer. It runs before the command is built, so a missing terminal writes no handoff files.

nodes.name: savedTerminal
nodes.summary: savedTerminal reads the chosen terminal id from the local config file, which the engine's manage settings share.

nodes.name: localConfigPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the local config file path shared with the engine's manage settings.

nodes.name: fidelity.go
nodes.summary: Restores full fidelity to transcripts before bundling by replacing truncated tool outputs and inlining UTF-8 attachments from provider blobs, within a byte budget.

nodes.name: FidelityReport
nodes.summary: FidelityReport records what full fidelity did and could not do.

nodes.name: ResolveFidelity
nodes.summary: ResolveFidelity returns a deep copy of transcripts with truncated tool outputs and attachment contents restored from blob. Restoration stops once MaxFidelityBytes of restored content has been added; later items keep their display form and are listed in the report.

nodes.name: resolveTool
nodes.summary: resolveTool replaces a truncated tool output with the full blob text. Binary blobs are not tool output, so they are reported and left as-is.

nodes.name: resolveFile
nodes.summary: resolveFile inlines an attachment's bytes into the part text when they are valid UTF-8. Binary attachments stay referenced: the bundle has no place for arbitrary bytes inside the transcript.

nodes.name: copyTranscript
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a transcript so fidelity restoration does not mutate the cached original.

nodes.name: ids.go
nodes.summary: Tiny helper building a model.SessionRef from an agent and session ID for bundle code.

nodes.name: manifest.go
nodes.summary: Defines the manifest.json schema of the .agent-session.zip portable session archive: root manifest, source metadata, per-session native file lists and redaction counts.

nodes.name: Manifest
nodes.summary: Manifest is the root manifest.json inside an .agent-session.zip bundle.

nodes.name: SourceMeta
nodes.summary: SourceMeta records the primary origin session details.

nodes.name: SessionManifest
nodes.summary: SessionManifest maps a session (root or child) and its verbatim files.

nodes.name: NativeFile
nodes.summary: NativeFile documents one verbatim native storage file inside native/<agent>/...

nodes.name: RedactionManifest
nodes.summary: RedactionManifest records redaction rule counts applied during bundle creation.

nodes.name: read.go
nodes.summary: Reads and validates .agent-session.zip bundles from disk, a ReaderAt or bytes, checking zip entries, manifest consistency, checksums and safe names.

nodes.name: Bundle
nodes.summary: Bundle is a validated archive. Native holds verbatim file bytes keyed by the zip-internal name (native/<agent>/...).

nodes.name: ReadFile
nodes.summary: ReadFile opens and validates a bundle from disk.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: Read reads and validates a bundle. size is the zip's total byte length, which archive/zip needs in order to find the central directory.

nodes.name: ReadBytes
nodes.summary: ReadBytes validates a bundle held entirely in memory.

nodes.name: readZip
nodes.summary: Reads manifest, transcripts and native entries from a zip reader into a Bundle, rejecting unsafe or duplicate names.

nodes.name: readEntry
nodes.summary: Reads one zip entry's bytes with a size limit.

nodes.name: validateBundle
nodes.summary: Validates a read bundle: format header, session list, checksums and sizes of native files, and safe IDs and paths.

nodes.name: safe.go
nodes.summary: Validation helpers ensuring bundle session IDs, agent names, relative paths and zip entry names cannot escape their roots or act as options.

nodes.name: safeIDPart
nodes.summary: Checks that one ID segment uses only the conservative safe charset.

nodes.name: safeRel
nodes.summary: safeRel reports whether rel is a relative path that stays inside its root.

nodes.name: safeZipName
nodes.summary: safeZipName reports whether a zip entry name is one of the three well-known files or a native/<agent>/<rel> path.

nodes.name: write.go
nodes.summary: Writes .agent-session.zip bundles atomically: validates the request, builds the manifest with checksums and sizes, and streams transcripts and native files into the zip.

nodes.name: NativeInput
nodes.summary: NativeInput is one verbatim native record to embed under native/<agent>/.

nodes.name: WriteRequest
nodes.summary: WriteRequest is everything the writer needs. The writer fills in manifest checksums, sizes and the format header; callers do not set those.

nodes.name: SessionInput
nodes.summary: SessionInput is one session (root or descendant) plus its native files.

nodes.name: WriteToFile
nodes.summary: WriteToFile writes the bundle to path atomically: a 0600 temp file in the same directory, fsync, then rename over the destination.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: Write writes the bundle to w. w is not closed.

nodes.name: writeZip
nodes.summary: Streams manifest, transcripts and native files into a zip archive on the writer.

nodes.name: buildManifest
nodes.summary: Builds the bundle Manifest from a write request, filling in checksums, sizes and the format header.

nodes.name: validateRequest
nodes.summary: Validates a bundle write request: profile, sessions, safe IDs and native file relative paths.

nodes.name: pathClean
nodes.summary: pathClean is filepath.Clean on slash-separated input without touching the OS separator, so the zip name is stable across platforms.

nodes.name: engine.go
nodes.summary: Central headless application engine owning the service, scanner, SQLite index refresher, FTS indexer, watcher, destructive-action manager and catalog event bus; implements the Backend API used by desktop and remote servers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Go's functional options pattern (With* returning Option) to configure NewEngine.

nodes.name: Engine
nodes.summary: Engine is the central headless application engine. It owns the service, scanner, indexer, watcher, destructive action manager, and catalog event bus.

nodes.name: WithEmitter
nodes.summary: WithEmitter sets the event emitter for catalog and indexer notifications.

nodes.name: WithCacheEnabled
nodes.summary: WithCacheEnabled toggles sqlite-backed caching on or off.

nodes.name: WithCacheDir
nodes.summary: WithCacheDir overrides the cache directory used by the engine.

nodes.name: WithRoots
nodes.summary: WithRoots configures explicit filesystem roots.

nodes.name: WithService
nodes.summary: WithService wires an explicit Service instance.

nodes.name: WithRunner
nodes.summary: WithRunner wires an explicit scan runner.

nodes.name: WithManage
nodes.summary: WithManage overrides the manage manager (useful in tests).

nodes.name: WithChatLaunch
nodes.summary: WithChatLaunch replaces how chats find the agent's ACP adapter (useful in tests).

nodes.name: NewEngine
nodes.summary: NewEngine creates an Engine instance with default options.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Service returns the underlying Service instance.

nodes.name: Refresher
nodes.summary: Refresher returns the underlying Refresher instance, if started.

nodes.name: Chats
nodes.summary: Chats returns the chat manager; nil for an engine not made by NewEngine.

nodes.name: Events
nodes.summary: Events returns the catalog bus.

nodes.name: SetEmitter
nodes.summary: SetEmitter updates the event emitter.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Start boots the engine's cache, catalog, indexer, watcher, and bootstrap scan. It is idempotent and safe to call multiple times.

nodes.name: startWatcher
nodes.summary: startWatcher rescans a provider when its files change. It looks up the refresher on each change because a reader swaps it when promoted.

nodes.name: refreshProvider
nodes.summary: refreshProvider rescans one provider. It looks up the refresher each time because a reader swaps it when promoted.

nodes.name: refreshAgent
nodes.summary: refreshAgent starts a rescan of agent's sessions, as the watcher would on a change, without waiting for it. A chat calls it when a turn ends so the saved records arrive quickly.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Scan triggers a scan across all providers.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close gracefully terminates background scans, watchers, indexers, and the database. It is idempotent and uses an explicit shutdown order.

nodes.name: cacheDir
nodes.summary: Returns the effective cache directory, falling back to the default when none is configured.

nodes.name: Ping
nodes.summary: Ping returns a greeting confirmation from the backend service.

nodes.name: ListGroups
nodes.summary: ListGroups returns the grouped navigation tree for the filtered snapshot.

nodes.name: ListSessions
nodes.summary: ListSessions returns session metadata for one group.

nodes.name: AgentCounts
nodes.summary: AgentCounts returns per-agent session totals across the filtered catalog.

nodes.name: GetSessionMeta
nodes.summary: GetSessionMeta returns the catalog metadata for one session.

nodes.name: GetMessages
nodes.summary: GetMessages returns one page of a session transcript.

nodes.name: GetMessagesCapped
nodes.summary: GetMessagesCapped returns one page of a session transcript within the size budget of pc (see PageCap).

nodes.name: GetBlob
nodes.summary: GetBlob returns provider-attached content referenced by a message part.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Search queries the full-text search index.

nodes.name: IndexProgress
nodes.summary: IndexProgress returns the status of background FTS indexing.

nodes.name: CopyResumeCommand
nodes.summary: CopyResumeCommand builds the provider resume command for a session.

nodes.name: RevealSource
nodes.summary: RevealSource reveals the session's source directory path.

nodes.name: ProjectSnapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a listing snapshot of a project directory via the service.

nodes.name: ListFiles
nodes.summary: ListFiles lists the files of a session directory.

nodes.name: BlameFile
nodes.summary: BlameFile returns blame for one saved line of a session directory file.

nodes.name: SearchFiles
nodes.summary: SearchFiles searches the text of a session directory's files.

nodes.name: ProbeFiles
nodes.summary: Observes the state of saved paths in a session directory via the service.

nodes.name: ReadFile
nodes.summary: Reads one file of a session directory, applying the engine's edit policy.

nodes.name: SaveFile
nodes.summary: SaveFile saves an edited file of a session directory.

nodes.name: ReplaceInFiles
nodes.summary: ReplaceInFiles replaces search matches in files of a session directory.

nodes.name: editPolicy
nodes.summary: editPolicy protects the agents' data stores and this app's own directories from the file editor, wherever a session directory is.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Diagnostics returns aggregated scanner health.

nodes.name: ensureManage
nodes.summary: Lazily creates the destructive-action manager from configured or default roots, honoring a test override.

nodes.name: claudeLiveFunc
nodes.summary: claudeLiveFunc reports whether a Claude session, or the parent of a subagent, is running. It checks with each call's own context: the manager outlives the call that created it, and an RPC server cancels every request's context once it has answered.

nodes.name: PreviewDelete
nodes.summary: PreviewDelete plans a destructive action over the given sessions.

nodes.name: DeleteSessions
nodes.summary: DeleteSessions executes a confirmed destructive plan.

nodes.name: SetManageOverride
nodes.summary: SetManageOverride overrides the destructive action manager (tests only).

nodes.name: TrashSupported
nodes.summary: TrashSupported reports whether the host system supports moving files to trash.

nodes.name: Forget
nodes.summary: Forget drops deleted sessions from the cache DB, catalog, and transcript LRU, then notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: forget
nodes.summary: Removes sessions from the refresher cache, catalog and transcript LRU, then notifies subscribers.

nodes.name: GetSettings
nodes.summary: GetSettings surfaces the current manage configuration.

nodes.name: SetManageEnabled
nodes.summary: SetManageEnabled toggles destructive actions.

nodes.name: SetAllowPermanentDelete
nodes.summary: SetAllowPermanentDelete toggles the permanent-delete allowance.

nodes.name: SetPrunePromptHistory
nodes.summary: SetPrunePromptHistory toggles removing deleted sessions from the agents' prompt history.

nodes.name: BuildHandoff
nodes.summary: BuildHandoff renders the handoff document preview.

nodes.name: HandoffCommand
nodes.summary: HandoffCommand writes the handoff files and returns the launch command.

nodes.name: SaveHandoff
nodes.summary: SaveHandoff writes the self-contained full handoff document to destPath.

nodes.name: RenderHandoff
nodes.summary: RenderHandoff builds the self-contained full handoff document text.

nodes.name: HandoffCache
nodes.summary: HandoffCache reports the handoff files kept on disk.

nodes.name: ClearHandoffCache
nodes.summary: ClearHandoffCache deletes the handoff files kept on disk.

nodes.name: PreviewExport
nodes.summary: PreviewExport estimates an export without writing anything.

nodes.name: ExportBundle
nodes.summary: ExportBundle writes the bundle to destPath.

nodes.name: OpenBundle
nodes.summary: OpenBundle opens and validates a bundle from disk.

nodes.name: OpenBundleBytes
nodes.summary: OpenBundleBytes opens and validates a bundle from raw bytes.

nodes.name: BuildBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: BuildBundleHandoff generates a handoff preview from an opened bundle.

nodes.name: BundleHandoffCommand
nodes.summary: BundleHandoffCommand writes the handoff files and returns the launch command.

nodes.name: SaveBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: SaveBundleHandoff writes the full handoff document to destPath.

nodes.name: RenderBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: RenderBundleHandoff builds the self-contained full handoff document text for an opened bundle.

nodes.name: export.go
nodes.summary: Service-level session export: resolves a session and its descendants, restores fidelity, renders the handoff, captures native records and writes or previews a bundle; also builds standard bundle file names.

nodes.name: ExportRequest
nodes.summary: ExportRequest configures a bundle export.

nodes.name: ExportPreview
nodes.summary: ExportPreview estimates an export without writing anything.

nodes.name: exportBuild
nodes.summary: exportBuild is one resolved export, shared by the preview and the writer so the two cannot drift.

nodes.name: PreviewExport
nodes.summary: PreviewExport reports what an export would contain. It reads transcripts and native records but writes nothing.

nodes.name: ExportBundle
nodes.summary: ExportBundle writes the bundle to destPath. An empty destPath means the caller cancelled, and nothing is written.

nodes.name: preview
nodes.summary: Derives the ExportPreview from a resolved export build.

nodes.name: request
nodes.summary: Derives the bundle.WriteRequest from a resolved export build so preview and writer stay consistent.

nodes.name: prepareExport
nodes.summary: prepareExport loads the session, restores full fidelity, renders the handoff, and (for a complete bundle) captures native records.

nodes.name: nativeSessions
nodes.summary: nativeSessions captures verbatim records for a complete bundle. Share-safe bundles list the sessions with no native entries.

nodes.name: sessionInputs
nodes.summary: sessionInputs builds one SessionInput per transcript, in transcript order. Captures the transcript walk did not produce a session for are appended, so a descendant that failed to load is still represented by its native record.

nodes.name: nativeInputs
nodes.summary: nativeInputs reads the captured files. OpenCode has no files: its export payload is the CLI's stdout, stored under export/<id>.json.

nodes.name: exportSessions
nodes.summary: exportSessions prefers the catalog, which carries descendants the scanner found. When the catalog has no entry, the provider is asked directly so a CLI export works from a plain Load without a prior scan.

nodes.name: parseProfile
nodes.summary: Parses the export profile name (complete or share-safe) into a bundle.Profile.

nodes.name: ExportFileName
nodes.summary: ExportFileName returns the standard sanitized filename for a session bundle: <agent>_<directory name>_<short id>.agent-session.zip, so bundles saved side by side say where they came from. Unknown parts are left out.

nodes.name: fileNamePart
nodes.summary: fileNamePart replaces characters that are unsafe in file names on any platform, and trims the dots and dashes left at either end.

nodes.name: handoff.go
nodes.summary: Service-level cross-agent handoff: builds the handoff document from a session and its descendants, writes prompt/context files, returns launch commands and manages the handoff file cache.

nodes.name: HandoffRequest
nodes.summary: HandoffRequest configures the creation of a cross-agent handoff document.

nodes.name: HandoffPreview
nodes.summary: HandoffPreview holds the rendered handoff prompt, report, and launch info.

nodes.name: HandoffCacheInfo
nodes.summary: HandoffCacheInfo describes the handoff files kept in the data directory.

nodes.name: saveHandoffFiles
nodes.summary: saveHandoffFiles writes the full context and the prompt for id and returns the prompt file the launch command points at.

nodes.name: HandoffCache
nodes.summary: HandoffCache reports the handoff files on disk.

nodes.name: ClearHandoffCache
nodes.summary: ClearHandoffCache deletes the handoff files and reports what remains.

nodes.name: buildHandoffDoc
nodes.summary: buildHandoffDoc resolves session metadata, collects descendants, and builds the handoff Doc and Report.

nodes.name: BuildHandoff
nodes.summary: BuildHandoff renders the handoff without modifying any files on disk. The command it shows points at the prompt file HandoffCommand will write.

nodes.name: HandoffCommand
nodes.summary: HandoffCommand writes the prompt and full context files (0600, pruned) and returns the launch command line, which points at the prompt file.

nodes.name: HandoffLaunch
nodes.summary: HandoffLaunch writes the prompt and full context files like HandoffCommand and returns the target agent's argv and working directory.

nodes.name: RenderHandoff
nodes.summary: RenderHandoff builds the self-contained full handoff document without saving it to disk.

nodes.name: SaveHandoff
nodes.summary: SaveHandoff writes a self-contained full handoff document (with no context file reference) to destPath with 0600 permissions.

nodes.name: import.go
nodes.summary: Opens and caches imported session bundles, summarizes them for review, and generates cross-agent handoffs (preview, command, launch, render, save) from bundle contents.

nodes.name: BundleSummary
nodes.summary: BundleSummary details an inspected session bundle for review and import.

nodes.name: BundleSessionSummary
nodes.summary: BundleSessionSummary details one session (root or subagent) inside a bundle.

nodes.name: BundleHandoffRequest
nodes.summary: BundleHandoffRequest configures generating a cross-agent handoff from an imported bundle.

nodes.name: summarizeBundle
nodes.summary: Builds a BundleSummary describing an opened bundle's source, sessions, sizes and redactions for review.

nodes.name: OpenBundle
nodes.summary: OpenBundle opens and validates a bundle from disk, caching it in memory.

nodes.name: OpenBundleBytes
nodes.summary: OpenBundleBytes opens and validates a bundle from raw bytes (useful in tests).

nodes.name: GetBundle
nodes.summary: GetBundle returns a previously opened bundle from cache.

nodes.name: buildBundleHandoffDoc
nodes.summary: Builds a handoff Doc and Report from a cached bundle's transcripts for the requested target.

nodes.name: BuildBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: BuildBundleHandoff renders a cross-agent handoff from an opened bundle.

nodes.name: BundleHandoffCommand
nodes.summary: BundleHandoffCommand writes the prompt and full context files (0600, pruned) and returns the launch command line for an opened bundle.

nodes.name: BundleHandoffLaunch
nodes.summary: BundleHandoffLaunch writes the prompt and full context files like BundleHandoffCommand and returns the target agent's argv and working directory.

nodes.name: RenderBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: RenderBundleHandoff builds the self-contained full handoff document without saving it to disk.

nodes.name: SaveBundleHandoff
nodes.summary: SaveBundleHandoff writes a self-contained full handoff document to destPath.

nodes.name: manage.go
nodes.summary: Frontend-facing types mirroring the destructive-action manager's preview and report, plus the persisted delete settings.

nodes.name: DeletePreview
nodes.summary: DeletePreview mirrors manage.Preview for the frontend.

nodes.name: DeleteReport
nodes.summary: DeleteReport mirrors manage.Report for the frontend.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Settings is the user's persisted destructive-action configuration.

nodes.name: repair_codex.go
nodes.summary: Engine entry point for repairing a Codex session through the manage package, with an optional backend interface for remote hosts.

nodes.name: CodexRepairBackend
nodes.summary: CodexRepairBackend is optional: older remote hosts never fall back locally.

nodes.name: RepairCodexSession
nodes.summary: Validates a session ref and repairs a Codex session's records through the manage package against the current catalog.

nodes.name: restore.go
nodes.summary: Engine methods that preview and execute restoring an opened bundle's native session records into the source agent's store under a chosen directory.

nodes.name: BundleRestoreRequest
nodes.summary: BundleRestoreRequest imports an opened bundle's native session records into the source agent's store, under a directory the user chose on this machine.

nodes.name: PreviewBundleRestore
nodes.summary: PreviewBundleRestore plans importing an opened bundle into req.CWD.

nodes.name: RestoreBundle
nodes.summary: RestoreBundle executes a previewed import.

nodes.name: restoreRequest
nodes.summary: Translates a BundleRestoreRequest into a manage.RestoreRequest using the cached bundle's native files.

nodes.name: group.go
nodes.summary: Builds the sidebar navigation tree from session metadata snapshots, grouping by directory, agent or both, with repository folding, home-relative labels and sorted output.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Node is a group or session in the visible navigation tree.

nodes.name: Options
nodes.summary: Options controls grouping and display without changing the metadata snapshot.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Build constructs a new navigation tree without changing sessions or reading the filesystem. An invalid mode uses DirAgent.

nodes.name: groupPath
nodes.summary: Returns the path a session groups under, folding to its repository root when requested.

nodes.name: agentNode
nodes.summary: Creates an agent group tree node with its display label.

nodes.name: pathLabel
nodes.summary: Formats a directory path as a display label, abbreviating the home directory.

nodes.name: collectSessionRefs
nodes.summary: Recursively gathers unique session refs below a node.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Converts internal tree nodes into sorted public Nodes with counts, optionally nested.

nodes.name: build.go
nodes.summary: Generates the cross-agent handoff markdown from session transcripts: target-specific adapters, preamble, facts, user messages, working state, timeline, last turns and closing, then trims to budget.

nodes.name: TargetAdapter
nodes.summary: TargetAdapter provides target-specific instructions and tool vocabulary.

nodes.name: getAdapter
nodes.summary: Returns the target agent's adapter with its display name, instructions and tool vocabulary mapping.

nodes.name: sourceName
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable name of the source agent.

nodes.name: Build
nodes.summary: Build creates the handoff document and report from session transcripts.

nodes.name: buildPreamble
nodes.summary: Renders the handoff preamble explaining the continuation to the target agent.

nodes.name: buildFacts
nodes.summary: Renders the session facts section (agent, IDs, directory, branch, times).

nodes.name: formatOriginalResume
nodes.summary: Formats the command that resumes the original session in its source agent.

nodes.name: buildUserMessages
nodes.summary: Renders the section listing the user's messages from the session.

nodes.name: buildCompaction
nodes.summary: Renders the latest compaction summary from the working state.

nodes.name: buildWorkingState
nodes.summary: Renders the working state section: files touched, commands run, plans and subagent tasks.

nodes.name: buildTimeline
nodes.summary: Renders the conversation timeline section from message turns.

nodes.name: buildLastTurns
nodes.summary: Renders the most recent turns with full tool output.

nodes.name: renderTurn
nodes.summary: Renders one message turn, optionally with reasoning and full tool output.

nodes.name: renderTool
nodes.summary: Renders one tool call with its input and (possibly truncated) output.

nodes.name: buildClosing
nodes.summary: Renders the closing section telling the target agent how to continue.

nodes.name: collect.go
nodes.summary: Collects a root session and its same-agent descendants via ParentID, ordered and cycle-safe, loading each transcript for handoff generation.

nodes.name: Collect
nodes.summary: Collect finds root and all its reachable descendants of the same agent via ParentID, ordered root first, then descendants ordered by CreatedAt (ascending) then ID (ascending), guarding against cycles. Each session's full transcript is loaded via the provided load function.

nodes.name: delivery.go
nodes.summary: Delivers handoff output: safe file paths and atomic 0600 writes for prompt and context files, pruning and cache usage, and building the target agent's launch argv and command.

nodes.name: HandoffDir
nodes.summary: HandoffDir returns the directory where full context markdown files are stored.

nodes.name: ContextFilePath
nodes.summary: ContextFilePath returns where SaveContextFile writes the full context for sessionID.

nodes.name: PromptFilePath
nodes.summary: PromptFilePath returns where SavePromptFile writes the handoff prompt for sessionID.

nodes.name: handoffFilePath
nodes.summary: handoffFilePath reduces the ID to a safe file name: Claude subagent IDs contain "/", and no ID may steer the path outside the handoff directory.

nodes.name: fileSafeID
nodes.summary: Reduces a session ID to a file-name-safe string.

nodes.name: SaveContextFile
nodes.summary: SaveContextFile writes the untrimmed markdown to ContextFilePath.

nodes.name: SavePromptFile
nodes.summary: SavePromptFile writes the handoff prompt to PromptFilePath.

nodes.name: writeHandoffFile
nodes.summary: writeHandoffFile writes markdown with 0600 permissions (temp file, fsync, rename) and prunes handoff files older than 30 days.

nodes.name: FilesUsage
nodes.summary: FilesUsage reports how many handoff files exist and their total size.

nodes.name: ClearFiles
nodes.summary: ClearFiles removes every handoff file this package wrote and reports how many were removed and their total size. Other files are left alone.

nodes.name: walkOwnFiles
nodes.summary: walkOwnFiles calls fn for each regular file in dir that this package owns.

nodes.name: LaunchPrompt
nodes.summary: LaunchPrompt returns the prompt the launch command carries: an instruction to read the prompt file, so the command stays one short line whatever the handoff size. Without a prompt file the prompt itself is passed.

nodes.name: BuildLaunchCommand
nodes.summary: BuildLaunchCommand generates the command line, for the local shell (see launch.Format), that starts the target agent with the prompt in cwd.

nodes.name: LaunchCommand
nodes.summary: LaunchCommand returns the argv and directory that start the target agent with the prompt (or the pointer to the prompt file).

nodes.name: LaunchArgv
nodes.summary: LaunchArgv returns the CLI argv for invoking the target agent with the prompt.

nodes.name: state.go
nodes.summary: Extracts working state (commands run, files touched, plans, subagent tasks) from transcript tool calls for the handoff document.

nodes.name: WorkingState
nodes.summary: WorkingState captures the extracted context from tool executions.

nodes.name: CommandRun
nodes.summary: CommandRun records a shell command invocation and its status.

nodes.name: SubagentSummary
nodes.summary: SubagentSummary describes a delegated subagent task.

nodes.name: ExtractWorkingState
nodes.summary: ExtractWorkingState scans transcripts for tool calls, plans, and files.

nodes.name: extractToolState
nodes.summary: Updates the working state from one tool call: shell commands, edited files, plans and subagent tasks.

nodes.name: extractPatchFiles
nodes.summary: Extracts file paths touched by an apply_patch input into the working state.

nodes.name: trim.go
nodes.summary: Fits the handoff prompt into a token budget by progressively trimming the timeline section (tool outputs, reasoning, older assistant text).

nodes.name: trimToBudget
nodes.summary: trimToBudget fits the prompt document within the requested token budget. Core sections (1-5, 7, 8) are preserved; timeline (section 6) is trimmed in order: 1) old tool outputs, 2) old reasoning, 3) older assistant text.

nodes.name: assemble
nodes.summary: Concatenates the eight handoff sections into one document.

nodes.name: buildTimelineWithoutToolOutputs
nodes.summary: Renders a timeline variant that omits older tool outputs to save tokens.

nodes.name: buildTimelineCondensed
nodes.summary: Renders a condensed timeline keeping only essential turn text.

nodes.name: types.go
nodes.summary: Type definitions for handoff generation options, the outcome report and the generated markdown documents.

nodes.name: Options
nodes.summary: Options configures the handoff generator.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Report details the generation outcome, trimming, and secret detection.

nodes.name: Doc
nodes.summary: Doc contains the generated markdown deliverables.

nodes.name: db.go
nodes.summary: Manages the private SQLite cache database: secure cache dir setup, opening with migrations and corruption recovery, catalog and scan-state loading, transactional scan commits, deletes and purge.

nodes.name: DB
nodes.summary: DB manages the private cache SQLite database. It coordinates single-writer access to prevent SQLITE_BUSY contention.

nodes.name: prepareCacheDir
nodes.summary: prepareCacheDir resolves cacheDir (the default when empty), creates it 0700 or enforces 0700, and refuses a symlink.

nodes.name: Open
nodes.summary: Open opens or initializes this schema's cache database for key (see FileName) in cacheDir, seeding a missing file from an older schema's database. Only the writer may call it: it migrates, and wipes a corrupt file.

nodes.name: startOver
nodes.summary: startOver empties the database Open found corrupt or of a newer schema. In place first: readers, possibly in other processes, may have the file open, and Windows refuses to delete it then.

nodes.name: recreateDB
nodes.summary: recreateDB deletes the database at dbPath with its sidecars and opens a fresh, migrated one in its place.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close closes the database connection.

nodes.name: Path
nodes.summary: Path returns the path to the SQLite index database file.

nodes.name: CacheDir
nodes.summary: CacheDir returns the path to the cache directory.

nodes.name: SQLDB
nodes.summary: SQLDB returns the underlying database handle for query execution.

nodes.name: Rebuild
nodes.summary: Rebuild empties the database in place and reapplies every embedded migration, in one transaction. The file and the handle stay the same, so it works while readers in this or other processes have the file open, and they see either the old index or the empty one.

nodes.name: LoadCatalog
nodes.summary: LoadCatalog returns all stored sessions from the cache, ordered newest first. Volatile liveness fields (Live, LiveStatus) are cleared.

nodes.name: loadCatalog
nodes.summary: Queries all stored session metadata newest first through a querier.

nodes.name: LoadState
nodes.summary: LoadState returns the persisted scan state for the given agent. If no state has been saved yet, an empty ScanState with an initialized Sources map is returned.

nodes.name: decodeState
nodes.summary: Decodes a provider ScanState from its stored JSON.

nodes.name: CommitScan
nodes.summary: CommitScan writes Changed and Removed sessions and updates the agent's ScanState atomically in a single transaction. It increments fts_revision for changed sessions and enqueues indexing jobs in fts_jobs.

nodes.name: DeleteSessions
nodes.summary: DeleteSessions removes the given sessions from the cache in a single transaction, deleting rows WHERE agent = ? AND id = ?.

nodes.name: Purge
nodes.summary: Purge drops what deleted sessions still leave in the file. Full-text deletes only add tombstones, so the index is merged to drop the deleted messages' terms, and the write-ahead log, which can hold copies of deleted pages, is checkpointed and truncated. secure_delete has zeroed the freed pages by then.

nodes.name: fts.go
nodes.summary: Builds full-text search documents from transcripts and reports background FTS indexing progress.

nodes.name: FTSProgress
nodes.summary: FTSProgress reports background indexing status to the UI.

nodes.name: buildFTSDocs
nodes.summary: buildFTSDocs extracts the searchable rows of one transcript. The title row comes first (messageIndex -1); each visible message contributes one row at its zero-based Messages index.

nodes.name: stripSentinels
nodes.summary: Removes snippet sentinel characters from indexed text.

nodes.name: Progress
nodes.summary: Progress snapshots the indexing queue and completion counters.

nodes.name: ftsProgress
nodes.summary: ftsProgress snapshots the indexing queue and completion counters.

nodes.name: refresh.go
nodes.summary: Refresher coordinating incremental per-provider scans, SQLite cache commits and in-memory catalog sync, with generations, single-flight locks, bootstrap, cache clearing, forgetting and diagnostics.

nodes.name: Refresher
nodes.summary: Refresher coordinates incremental session scanning, private cache commits, and in-memory catalog synchronization across providers.

nodes.name: WithWorkers
nodes.summary: WithWorkers configures worker concurrency for Bootstrap scans.

nodes.name: WithOnChanged
nodes.summary: WithOnChanged sets the initial change notification callback.

nodes.name: WithStates
nodes.summary: WithStates seeds the scan states of a Refresher without a database, such as a reader's, so its first scans are incremental from that point.

nodes.name: NewRefresher
nodes.summary: NewRefresher creates a Refresher with the given cache DB, in-memory catalog, and provider set.

nodes.name: SetOnChanged
nodes.summary: SetOnChanged sets or replaces the change notification callback.

nodes.name: Generation
nodes.summary: Generation returns the current refresher generation counter.

nodes.name: BumpGeneration
nodes.summary: BumpGeneration increments the generation counter, causing any in-flight asynchronous scan to be discarded before commit.

nodes.name: DB
nodes.summary: DB returns the underlying cache database instance.

nodes.name: Catalog
nodes.summary: Catalog returns the underlying in-memory session catalog.

nodes.name: Refresh
nodes.summary: Refresh performs an incremental scan for a single provider. One Refresh invocation per provider at a time; scan.Provider remains M0.

nodes.name: refreshLive
nodes.summary: refreshLive re-reads which of a provider's sessions run when no session changed: an agent going busy or idle may only rewrite its status file. Sessions whose badge changed are notified and returned.

nodes.name: Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Bootstrap scans all detected providers concurrently and updates the cache. Startup calls index.Open and LoadCatalog first for instant first paint; Bootstrap runs asynchronously.

nodes.name: providerLocks
nodes.summary: providerLocks snapshots every per-provider single-flight lock so ClearCache can exclude in-flight Refresh calls wholesale. Lock ordering is safe: a Refresh holds at most one lock at a time, so it can never wait on a lock another Refresh holds while ClearCache waits on it.

nodes.name: Retire
nodes.summary: Retire stops this Refresher from touching the catalog again, so another one can take it over. It returns once every Refresh in flight has finished; later calls return without scanning.

nodes.name: ClearCache
nodes.summary: ClearCache bumps the generation, rebuilds the private SQLite cache DB, and only after a successful rebuild clears the in-memory catalog and states. It holds every provider's single-flight lock throughout so an in-flight Refresh cannot commit into the freshly rebuilt database.

nodes.name: Forget
nodes.summary: Forget deletes the given sessions from the private cache and the in-memory catalog.

nodes.name: Purge
nodes.summary: Purge drops deleted sessions' leftovers from the cache file; see DB.Purge.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Report returns an aggregated snapshot of provider diagnostics, errors, and scan states.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Diagnostics returns aggregated scanner diagnostics across all providers.

nodes.name: DiagnosticsByProvider
nodes.summary: DiagnosticsByProvider returns diagnostics keyed by provider ID.

nodes.name: ScanErrors
nodes.summary: ScanErrors returns the last scan error string keyed by provider ID.

nodes.name: States
nodes.summary: States returns a copy of the current in-memory provider scan states.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close closes the underlying cache database if present.

nodes.name: getProviderLock
nodes.summary: Returns the single-flight mutex for an agent, creating it on first use.

nodes.name: hasStateChanged
nodes.summary: Reports whether a provider scan state differs from the previous one.

nodes.name: search.go
nodes.summary: Full-text session search: parses the user query grammar into a safe FTS5 MATCH expression with agent and dir filters, runs parameterized queries and renders snippets.

nodes.name: SearchFilter
nodes.summary: SearchFilter narrows full-text search results.

nodes.name: SearchHit
nodes.summary: SearchHit is one ranked search result.

nodes.name: parseSearchQuery
nodes.summary: parseSearchQuery converts raw user input into a safe FTS5 MATCH expression.

nodes.name: SearchTerms
nodes.summary: SearchTerms returns the search terms of a query under the grammar and limits of parseSearchQuery: plain words and the text of quoted phrases, in order, with agent: and dir: prefixes dropped. A query without terms is an error.

nodes.name: tokenizeSearchQuery
nodes.summary: tokenizeSearchQuery splits a query into its terms and filter prefixes, enforcing the input limits.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Search runs a safe full-text query over indexed session content. Rows are only visible when the session's indexed revision is current (fts_indexed_revision = fts_revision), so sessions queued for reindexing never surface stale indices.

nodes.name: dirsContaining
nodes.summary: dirsContaining lists the indexed cwd and repo root values containing path, which is lowercase. It matches in Go, as the session list does, because SQLite only folds ASCII case.

nodes.name: searchRows
nodes.summary: searchRows executes the parameterized FTS query. User text only ever reaches SQLite as a bound argument.

nodes.name: dirChildPattern
nodes.summary: dirChildPattern builds a pattern matching the path children of dir: a GLOB pattern with *, ? and [ escaped for a POSIX dir, and a LIKE pattern with %, _ and \ escaped for a Windows one. A path separator in dir's style precedes the trailing wildcard so /repo does not match /repo-other, nor C:\repo C:\repo-other.

nodes.name: intersectAgents
nodes.summary: Intersects the filter's agents with agents parsed from the query.

nodes.name: shared.go
nodes.summary: Multi-process sharing of the index database: schema/roots-keyed file names, writer file locks, read-only opens, snapshots, seeding from older schemas via VACUUM INTO, and cleanup of stale copies.

nodes.name: Lock
nodes.summary: Lock makes its holder the writer of one database in a cache dir.

nodes.name: SchemaVersion
nodes.summary: SchemaVersion is the newest bundled migration.

nodes.name: RootsKey
nodes.summary: RootsKey names the index of one set of provider roots: processes that scan the same roots share it.

nodes.name: FileName
nodes.summary: FileName is the database file for a schema version and roots key. An empty key, used by tests and tools with no roots, gives index-v<N>.db.

nodes.name: TryLock
nodes.summary: TryLock takes the writer lock for this build's schema and key in cacheDir without waiting. ErrLocked means another process is the writer; open the database with OpenReadOnly instead.

nodes.name: Unlock
nodes.summary: Unlock releases the writer role. Close the database first.

nodes.name: OpenReadOnly
nodes.summary: OpenReadOnly opens this build's database for key in cacheDir without writing to it: no migrations, no integrity repair, query_only. It fails with ErrNoIndex before a writer has created the file, and until the writer has migrated it to this schema.

nodes.name: Replaced
nodes.summary: Replaced reports whether the file this read-only handle opened is no longer the one at its path, because a writer had to delete a damaged file or it was cleaned up. The handle then reads a stale copy and should be reopened.

nodes.name: LoadSnapshot
nodes.summary: LoadSnapshot reads the catalog and every provider's scan state in one read transaction, so the states describe exactly the sessions returned. A reader seeds its in-memory scanner from it: sessions changed after the snapshot differ from the states and are rescanned.

nodes.name: seedCandidates
nodes.summary: Lists older-schema database files that can seed a new database for a key.

nodes.name: vacuumInto
nodes.summary: Copies a source database into a new file with VACUUM INTO, checking its schema version.

nodes.name: Cleanup
nodes.summary: Cleanup deletes the databases of other schemas and keys that no process has used for unusedFor. A file is only touched while this call holds its lock, so a running writer's file is never removed; a legacy index.db has no lock, so only its age protects it.

nodes.name: DropCopies
nodes.summary: DropCopies deletes the other databases that may hold copies of this key's sessions: other schemas of the same key, keyless ones and the legacy index.db. It runs after sessions are deleted, so their text does not live on in a database kept for switching app versions; such a version rebuilds its index when next started.

nodes.name: listDir
nodes.summary: Lists file names in a directory, empty on error.

nodes.name: parseIndexFile
nodes.summary: parseIndexFile matches "index-v<N>.db" and "index-v<N>-<key>.db", the key being lowercase hex.

nodes.name: worker.go
nodes.summary: Background FTS indexer worker that processes persisted indexing jobs, loads transcripts outside write transactions, replaces FTS docs and maintains or rebuilds the full-text index.

nodes.name: TranscriptLoader
nodes.summary: TranscriptLoader loads a session's transcript for indexing. The result must be no older than the session's source when LoadForIndex was called: a job is queued after the scan that saw the change, so any later read covers it.

nodes.name: Indexer
nodes.summary: Indexer runs one background FTS worker, loading transcripts outside write transactions. Jobs are persisted in SQLite, so shutdown/restart resumes at the next revision without losing work.

nodes.name: ProviderLoader
nodes.summary: ProviderLoader loads transcripts directly from providers, parsing each session in full.

nodes.name: LoadForIndex
nodes.summary: Loads a session transcript in full from its provider for indexing.

nodes.name: StartIndexer
nodes.summary: StartIndexer begins indexing pending jobs. Stop before closing the database.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.summary: Notify prompts a queue check after a scanner commit. The periodic check still catches jobs after a restart or commits without a notification.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close cancels the worker and waits until it has stopped using the DB.

nodes.name: IndexPending
nodes.summary: IndexPending processes all jobs present, without starting a long-lived goroutine. It is useful when importing or rebuilding an index from a CLI; it honors the same debounce and cancellation rules as the background worker.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main indexer loop: polls and is notified of jobs, debounces, processes the queue and emits throttled progress.

nodes.name: processUntilEmpty
nodes.summary: Processes pending FTS jobs until the queue is empty or the context is cancelled.

nodes.name: pendingFTSJobs
nodes.summary: Queries the pending FTS indexing jobs.

nodes.name: processJob
nodes.summary: Loads one job's transcript and replaces its FTS docs, recording failures.

nodes.name: replaceFTSDocs
nodes.summary: Replaces a session's FTS documents in one transaction, updating only changed rows and marking the revision indexed.

nodes.name: maintainFTS
nodes.summary: maintainFTS rebuilds the full-text index from fts_docs when it is bloated or fails FTS5's own integrity check, which Open leaves out because it reads the whole index. A rebuild only reads fts_docs, so it is cheap however big the old index is.

nodes.name: rebuildFTS
nodes.summary: rebuildFTS replaces the full-text index with one built from fts_docs, and truncates the write-ahead log, which by then holds the zeroed old pages.

nodes.name: storedFTSDocs
nodes.summary: storedFTSDocs returns ref's indexed docs by message index.

nodes.name: failFTSJob
nodes.summary: Records a failed FTS job with its load error for later retry.

nodes.name: jsonl.go
nodes.summary: Resumable newline-delimited JSON reader tracking byte offsets, skipping oversized lines and exposing trailing partial lines, plus a fast top-level type extractor.

nodes.name: Reader
nodes.summary: Reader tracks the offset of the last complete line in a JSONL stream.

nodes.name: Open
nodes.summary: Open opens a file read-only at offset, which should be an earlier Offset().

nodes.name: NewReader
nodes.summary: NewReader wraps an io.Reader already positioned at offset. For an existing file, use Open instead to perform the seek.

nodes.name: Next
nodes.summary: Next returns the next complete, non-empty line without its newline, plus the byte offset where it started. A trailing '\r' from CRLF is also removed.

nodes.name: skipLong
nodes.summary: skipLong discards through the newline after an oversized line. If no newline is available yet, it retains only the byte count, not its content.

nodes.name: Trailing
nodes.summary: Trailing returns an incomplete, unterminated final line after Next reached EOF. A line over MaxLineLen is discarded, so Trailing is nil for that case.

nodes.name: Offset
nodes.summary: Offset is the byte offset just past the last complete line, including skipped empty or oversized lines. It excludes an incomplete trailing line.

nodes.name: LineNo
nodes.summary: LineNo is the number of complete, non-empty lines returned by Next since this reader was constructed (not the file's absolute line number).

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close closes files opened by Open. A source passed to NewReader remains owned by the caller and is not closed.

nodes.name: Type
nodes.summary: Type extracts the top-level "type" value from a record. gjson.GetBytes skips nested fields even when they precede the top-level key. This is field extraction only, not validation of the complete JSON record.

nodes.name: command.go
nodes.summary: Turns an agent command into a runnable one-line shell command: POSIX and PowerShell quoting, cd/Set-Location prefixes and argument validation for PowerShell 5.1.

nodes.name: Format
nodes.summary: Format renders cmd as one line for the local shell: PowerShell 5 syntax on Windows (where `&&` and POSIX quoting do not work), POSIX sh elsewhere. On Windows an agent CLI found only outside PATH, such as one bundled with a desktop app, is called by its full path, with its interactive defaults.

nodes.name: formatFor
nodes.summary: Renders a command for a given OS: PowerShell syntax on Windows (resolving CLIs outside PATH via find), POSIX sh elsewhere.

nodes.name: commandLine
nodes.summary: commandLine inserts interactive defaults without modifying the caller's arguments. An already-prepared argument prefix isn't duplicated.

nodes.name: PosixCommand
nodes.summary: PosixCommand renders argv for a POSIX shell, changing into dir first: cd '<dir>' && claude --resume '<id>'.

nodes.name: ShellEscape
nodes.summary: ShellEscape quotes a single argument for POSIX shells. Arguments that are safe unquoted are passed through; everything else is single-quoted with embedded quotes escaped the POSIX way ('"'"').

nodes.name: SafeUnquoted
nodes.summary: SafeUnquoted reports whether arg can appear unquoted in a POSIX shell without changing meaning.

nodes.name: JoinCommand
nodes.summary: JoinCommand builds "argv0 argv1 …" with each argument escaped.

nodes.name: PowerShellCommand
nodes.summary: PowerShellCommand renders argv as one line that works in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7. A failed Set-Location stops the line, so the agent never starts in the wrong directory. argv[0] is called with the call operator unless it is a bare command name.

nodes.name: PowerShellQuote
nodes.summary: PowerShellQuote quotes a single argument for PowerShell. Plain words pass through; everything else becomes a verbatim single-quoted string, in which PowerShell expands nothing ($, `, @ and , are literal).

nodes.name: powerShellSafe
nodes.summary: Reports whether an argument can appear unquoted in PowerShell.

nodes.name: ValidateArgs
nodes.summary: ValidateArgs checks that args reach exe exactly as given when PowerShell 5.1 starts it. It mangles empty arguments, embedded double quotes and a trailing backslash in an argument it has to quote; npm .cmd shims also run through cmd.exe, which expands %VAR% even inside quotes.

nodes.name: find.go
nodes.summary: Locates agent CLIs (claude, codex, opencode) on PATH and in installer, desktop-app and editor-extension locations, with WSL Windows-drive detection via mountinfo.
nodes.languageNotes: Go struct of injectable function fields (finder) replaces OS calls so cross-platform lookup logic is testable on any host.

nodes.name: Executable
nodes.summary: Executable is an agent CLI found on this machine.

nodes.name: finder
nodes.summary: Injectable environment (OS, lookups, filesystem) for locating agent CLIs, enabling cross-platform tests.

nodes.name: Find
nodes.summary: Find locates the CLI for an agent command name ("claude", "codex" or "opencode"). On Windows it also looks where the agents' installers, desktop apps and editor extensions keep their own copy, because desktop-only users rarely have one on PATH.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Searches PATH and known install locations for an agent CLI, skipping Windows-drive copies inside WSL.

nodes.name: wslWindowsDrive
nodes.summary: wslWindowsDrive returns the test for a path on a mounted Windows drive, which reports false everywhere but inside WSL.

nodes.name: parseMountInfo
nodes.summary: parseMountInfo reads the mount points and whether each is a Windows drive: drvfs under WSL 1, 9p with aname=drvfs under WSL 2. Malformed lines are skipped.

nodes.name: unescapeMount
nodes.summary: unescapeMount decodes the \ooo escapes mountinfo writes for space, tab, newline and backslash in a mount point.

nodes.name: onWindowsMount
nodes.summary: onWindowsMount reports whether the innermost mount holding path is a Windows drive. Of mounts on the same point, the last listed is on top.

nodes.name: bundleArgs
nodes.summary: bundleArgs also recognizes a bundled CLI put on PATH. Reuse the lookup locations, resolving short names before comparing the paths on Windows.

nodes.name: posixDirs
nodes.summary: posixDirs returns the directories to search for name, in order: a custom OpenCode install dir, the per-CLI home dirs, the system dirs, then nvm's Node versions, the newest first.

nodes.name: windowsLocations
nodes.summary: windowsLocations lists where agent CLIs live besides PATH, in order of preference: standalone installs, then desktop apps, then editor extensions. Codex's bundled copies need daemon auto-start disabled for interactive launches; --version alone doesn't verify package completeness.

nodes.name: expand
nodes.summary: expand returns the paths below dir matching parts. Wildcards are matched against directory entries, never against dir itself, so a user directory containing glob characters is still found.

nodes.name: newestFile
nodes.summary: newestFile returns the most recently modified regular file of paths, so the latest of several installed versions wins.

nodes.name: installHint
nodes.summary: Returns an install hint for an agent CLI that was not found.

nodes.name: panel.go
nodes.summary: Builds argv for the built-in terminal panel: agent runs, plain shells with OSC7 cwd reporting, POSIX bootstrap/login scripts and WSL invocations.

nodes.name: PanelArgv
nodes.summary: PanelArgv returns what the app's built-in terminal panel runs for cmd on this computer, in cmd.Dir: the script an external terminal runs, except that it exits with the agent's status rather than staying in the user's shell, so the tab closes when the agent exits.

nodes.name: PanelShellArgv
nodes.summary: PanelShellArgv returns the plain shell a panel tab runs on this computer: the user's shell with ephemeral prompt-time OSC7 cwd reporting, or Windows PowerShell with its profile's prompt wrapped. Unknown POSIX shells fall back to an unmodified login shell.

nodes.name: PanelShellScript
nodes.summary: PanelShellScript is the /bin/sh script a WSL or SSH host's shell tab runs: it enters dir when there is one and it exists, then becomes the user's login shell. An unconfigured locale defaults to an installed UTF-8 locale on that host, so the shell can edit the terminal's Unicode input.

nodes.name: PosixBootstrapArgv
nodes.summary: PosixBootstrapArgv runs script with /bin/sh. The script travels in OctalEscape form, so the argv means the same to whatever shell an ssh server runs it with, fish and tcsh included (see bootstrapLine).

nodes.name: PosixLoginArgv
nodes.summary: PosixLoginArgv runs script with /bin/sh in the environment of the user's login shell, whatever that shell is.

nodes.name: WSLPanelArgv

nodes.name: panelPosixStartupScript

nodes.name: Supported

nodes.name: OpenTerminal

nodes.name: terminalScript

nodes.name: terminals.go

nodes.name: WSLBinary

nodes.name: OpenWSLTerminal
nodes.summary: OpenWSLTerminal opens a WSL distro's terminal, which only Windows can.

nodes.name: startProcess
nodes.summary: startProcess starts app with argv in dir and returns its process handle. os/exec cannot be used: it always passes standard handles (NUL when unset), so the shell and the agent would read NUL instead of the new console, and PowerShell exits at once despite -NoExit.

nodes.name: OpenWSLTerminal
nodes.summary: OpenWSLTerminal opens a new console running script with /bin/sh in distro. The script, from PosixTerminalScript, enters the session's directory itself and ends in the user's shell, so the window stays as -NoExit keeps PowerShell's.

nodes.name: WSLBinary

nodes.name: windowsPowerShell
nodes.summary: windowsPowerShell returns the system powershell.exe, never whichever one a GUI launch finds on PATH.

nodes.name: Error

nodes.name: ChooseTerminal

nodes.name: SystemTerminalEnv

nodes.name: Detect

nodes.name: locate

nodes.name: scriptable

nodes.name: Auto
nodes.summary: Auto picks the terminal to use when none is chosen: on Linux the one $TERMINAL names, then the desktop's own, then the first found; on macOS Terminal.

nodes.name: desktopTerminals

nodes.name: Name

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve returns the terminal for a Settings choice among apps: id, or Auto when id is empty.

nodes.name: OpenIn

nodes.name: open

nodes.name: checkCommand

It enters dir or stops, runs the agent with its own directory first on PATH (so an npm shim's `env node` finds the Node it was installed with), reports a failure, and then replaces itself with the user's login shell so the window stays.

nodes.name: OctalEscape

nodes.name: PosixTerminalScript

nodes.name: PosixPanelScript
nodes.summary: PosixPanelScript is PosixTerminalScript for a tab in the app's terminal panel: the script ends when the agent does.

nodes.name: runOSAScript

nodes.name: scriptError

nodes.name: TerminalApp

nodes.name: TerminalEnv

nodes.name: WSLLoginExecArgs

nodes.name: pruneHistoryFile
nodes.summary: pruneHistoryFile drops the JSONL lines whose field is one of ids and atomically replaces the file, keeping its mode.

nodes.name: procLive

nodes.name: Cmdlines
nodes.summary: Cmdlines returns pid -> argv for readable /proc entries.

nodes.name: ProcFS
nodes.summary: ProcFS abstracts /proc for the process scan, overridable in tests.

nodes.name: imageProcFS
nodes.summary: imageProcFS supplies executable names, and arguments only on request for processes already identified as Codex or OpenCode.

nodes.name: liveGuard

nodes.summary: Option that overrides the clock, mainly for tests.

nodes.summary: Option that sets the trash transport used for Claude sessions.

nodes.summary: Delete preview returned to callers: planned items, total bytes, the trash label and the sealed token required to confirm.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Summary of a delete run: per-item results, deleted/failed counts, freed bytes, forgotten session refs and cleanup notes.
