nodes.name: discoverWithDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Lists dated and archived rollout files, recording diagnostics for unreadable entries.

nodes.name: visitDirs
nodes.summary: Walks year/month/day directories to a fixed depth, collecting rollout files.

nodes.name: digits
nodes.summary: Checks that a name is exactly width decimal digits.

nodes.name: withinRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves symlinks and checks that a path stays inside the Codex root.

nodes.name: indexDBPath
nodes.summary: Chooses the highest-numbered state_N.sqlite inside the Codex root without opening it.

nodes.name: incremental.go
nodes.summary: Incremental Codex rollout loading that reads only appended bytes, tracks unanswered tool calls and bounds retained parser state.

nodes.name: LoadIncremental
nodes.summary: Continues parsing the canonical rollout from the previous state when the file was only appended.

nodes.name: loadRolloutIncremental
nodes.summary: Core incremental rollout load: validates state, parses new lines and publishes transcript.

nodes.name: pendingUnknown
nodes.summary: Computes publish-time finalization of unanswered tool calls.

nodes.name: unknownDiff
nodes.summary: Finds the earliest message whose tool finalization changed.

nodes.name: retainedBytes
nodes.summary: Estimates retained parser storage beyond the published snapshot.

nodes.name: loadState
nodes.summary: Committed Codex rollout parse through an offset with retained-bytes accounting.

nodes.name: index.go
nodes.summary: Reads the Codex SQLite threads index as advisory metadata, validates indexed rollout paths against the root, and merges index metadata with parsed data.

nodes.name: readIndex
nodes.summary: Reads the threads index as advisory metadata; failures become diagnostics, cancellation stays fatal.

nodes.name: loadIndex
nodes.summary: Queries the Codex SQLite threads table using an allowlisted column set.

nodes.name: indexRolloutPath
nodes.summary: Validates a DB-supplied rollout path as a regular JSONL file inside the root, lexically and physically.

nodes.name: mergeIndexedMeta
nodes.summary: Merges index metadata over parsed metadata while keeping rollout-only fields and counts.

nodes.name: load.go
nodes.summary: Full Codex rollout loader that turns response items, reasoning, tool calls/outputs and events into model messages and parts.

nodes.name: rolloutFor
nodes.summary: Resolves the canonical rollout metadata for a ref using the scan resolver instead of trusting the ref ID.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Reconstructs a Codex transcript from its validated rollout.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Decodes a rollout line and dispatches by record type.

nodes.name: response
nodes.summary: Dispatches a response item to message, reasoning or tool handlers.

nodes.name: message
nodes.summary: Appends a user or assistant message from a response item.

nodes.name: content
nodes.summary: Converts content parts into model parts, including images by data MIME.

nodes.name: reasoning
nodes.summary: Adds reasoning summary parts to the current assistant turn.

nodes.name: tool
nodes.summary: Adds a tool call part for function or custom tool calls.

nodes.name: toolOutput
nodes.summary: Attaches tool output to its call, clipping large outputs.

nodes.name: outputText
nodes.summary: Extracts tool output text from string or structured content.

nodes.name: event
nodes.summary: Handles event_msg records such as errors and notices.

nodes.name: dataMIME
nodes.summary: Reads only the MIME prefix of a data URL so image bytes never enter transcripts.

nodes.name: rolloutLoader
nodes.summary: Transcript builder for Codex rollouts with copy-on-write message updates.

nodes.name: resolve.go
nodes.summary: Resolver that keeps the last private Codex scan state so session lookups only re-read changed rollouts and coalesce concurrent callers.

nodes.name: resolveAfter
nodes.summary: Returns canonical metadata only from a scan started after the caller arrived.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Runs a warm scan and replaces retained state on success, falling back to a cold scan on failure.

nodes.name: retainedResolution
nodes.summary: Estimates checkpoint and metadata storage retained by the resolver.

nodes.name: resolver
nodes.summary: Retains the last private scan state so lookups read only changed rollouts, coalescing callers.

nodes.name: scan_rollout.go
nodes.summary: Codex rollout metadata scanner with resumable checkpoints, session meta, turn state and token accounting, duplicate rollout preference and parallel per-file scanning.

nodes.name: consume
nodes.summary: Consumes one rollout line into checkpoint state, dispatching by envelope type.

nodes.name: consumeEnvelopeLess
nodes.summary: Handles legacy rollout lines without a type envelope.

nodes.name: consumeSessionMeta
nodes.summary: Records session ID, CWD, timestamps and subagent parent from session_meta.

nodes.name: consumeResponseItem
nodes.summary: Updates counts and turn state from response items such as messages and tool calls.

nodes.name: handleMessage
nodes.summary: Counts conversational messages and captures the first prompt.

nodes.name: isConversationalUser
nodes.summary: Determines whether user content is a real prompt, returning its text.

nodes.name: isInjectedContext
nodes.summary: Detects injected context blocks (instructions, environment) in user text.

nodes.name: consumeEventMsg
nodes.summary: Updates token usage and turn state from event_msg records.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Produces SessionMeta from checkpoint state and rollout path.

nodes.name: isArchivedPath
nodes.summary: Reports whether a rollout lives under archived_sessions.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Parses rollout metadata from discovered JSONL files and returns changed sessions.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.summary: Full scan: discovers rollouts, reads the index, scans files in parallel, dedupes by ID and merges index metadata.

nodes.name: preferRollout
nodes.summary: Prefers the newer rollout for duplicate IDs, active over archived on ties.

nodes.name: scanSource
nodes.summary: Scans one rollout, resuming from a cached or prior checkpoint when only appended.

nodes.name: checkpoint
nodes.summary: Resumable Codex scanner state with counts, usage, turn state and subagent ancestry.

nodes.name: source.go
nodes.summary: Codex provider's source-proof machinery: digests all selectable rollout sources and SQLite state to validate canonical scan metadata, then implements LoadFromSource/BlobFromSource on top of it.

nodes.name: proveSources
nodes.summary: sourceProof reads bytes, not rollout records. A digest of ALL selectable sources excludes same-stat rewrites and competing duplicates.

nodes.name: sameProof
nodes.summary: Compares two source proofs for equality of digests and file evidence.

nodes.name: establishSource
nodes.summary: establishSource resolves once on an optional cold call. Ordinary Scan/Load never hash sources.

nodes.name: sourceMeta
nodes.summary: Resolves canonical session metadata for a ref, validating the scan hint against the current source proof and optionally performing a cold resolution.

nodes.name: LoadFromSource
nodes.summary: Codex SourceLoader implementation: loads a transcript using validated canonical scan metadata, returning ErrStaleSource when the hint no longer matches.

nodes.name: BlobFromSource
nodes.summary: Codex SourceBlobLoader implementation: retrieves a blob using validated canonical source metadata.

nodes.name: source_work.go
nodes.summary: Opt-in context-scoped counters (SourceWork) for Codex source-proof reconciliation work, used by benchmarks.

nodes.name: SourceWork
nodes.summary: SourceWork accounts for optional proof reconciliation, separately from parsed ScanWork records. Bytes counts all digest reads, including failed proofs.

nodes.name: WithSourceWork
nodes.summary: Attaches a SourceWork collector to a context for one request.

nodes.name: continuity.go
nodes.summary: Defines ContinuityMark, which cheaply verifies that an append-only transcript file still has the same prefix by checking identity, size/mtime and hashed head and tail windows.

nodes.name: ContinuityMark
nodes.summary: ContinuityMark validates an append-only prefix without rereading the full file. It detects identity, same-size mtime, head and committed-tail changes.

nodes.name: MarkContinuity
nodes.summary: MarkContinuity records the prefix through offset on an already opened source. The caller must pass the last complete-line boundary, not a best-effort tail.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Validate returns false when continuity is lost, including a missing source. I/O and cancellation errors are returned rather than interpreted as a match.

nodes.name: ValidateFile
nodes.summary: ValidateFile validates the descriptor that the caller will continue reading.

nodes.name: continuityHash
nodes.summary: Hashes a bounded window of the source file for continuity comparison.

nodes.name: diagnostics.go
nodes.summary: Capped collection of non-fatal scanner warnings and unknown-record counters shared by all providers.

nodes.name: Warning
nodes.summary: Warning is a non-fatal problem encountered while scanning.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Diagnostics aggregates non-fatal scanner problems. Warnings are capped; Dropped counts how many were discarded beyond the cap.

nodes.name: Warn
nodes.summary: Warn records a warning, dropping it (and counting it) once the cap is hit.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.summary: Unknown counts an unrecognized record type by name.

nodes.name: Merge
nodes.summary: Merge folds another Diagnostics into d. Merged warnings fill the cap in order; anything beyond the cap (in o or from overflow) counts as Dropped.

nodes.name: incremental.go
nodes.summary: Declares the optional IncrementalLoader interface and opaque TranscriptState used to continue transcript parsing, plus a helper that falls back to a full Load.

nodes.name: TranscriptState
nodes.summary: TranscriptState is opaque provider-owned parser state. Callers hand it back at most once, including on failure or cancellation.

nodes.name: IncrementalResult
nodes.summary: IncrementalResult publishes an immutable transcript and optionally its resume state. All nested slices, pointers and raw input bytes in Transcript must stay unchanged through future loads.

nodes.name: IncrementalLoader
nodes.summary: IncrementalLoader optionally continues a transcript parser. prev is consumed even on error and must never be reused.

nodes.name: LoadIncremental
nodes.summary: LoadIncremental uses the optional loader, or publishes Load as a full rebuild.

nodes.name: loadwork.go
nodes.summary: Context-scoped load accounting and helpers that open JSONL transcript readers with optional byte counting.

nodes.name: LoadWork
nodes.summary: LoadWork is optional synthetic-load accounting. SourceBytes counts bytes delivered by file Read calls to transcript readers (including incomplete tails), not physical disk I/O.

nodes.name: WithLoadWork
nodes.summary: WithLoadWork attaches a concurrency-safe collector to loads using ctx only.

nodes.name: LoadWorkFromContext
nodes.summary: LoadWorkFromContext returns the optional load collector, or nil.

nodes.name: OpenLoadSource
nodes.summary: OpenLoadSource opens a transcript reader with opt-in byte accounting. The caller closes the returned Closer; without a collector this is jsonl.Open.

nodes.name: OpenLoadFile
nodes.summary: OpenLoadFile opens a transcript whose descriptor is validated and then read with LoadReader, counting the open like OpenLoadSource.

nodes.name: LoadReader
nodes.summary: LoadReader positions f at a committed line boundary and reads it with opt-in byte accounting. The caller keeps ownership of f.

nodes.name: blob.go
nodes.summary: Fetches individual OpenCode file attachments or tool outputs on demand from v1/v2 SQLite stores, including data-URI decoding and blob-key parsing.

nodes.name: Blob
nodes.summary: Blob retrieves one v1/v2 file or tool output on demand. Legacy JSON keys remain unsupported until their loader is implemented.

nodes.name: blobV1
nodes.summary: Retrieves a file or tool-output blob from the OpenCode v1 part table.

nodes.name: decodeDataURI
nodes.summary: Decodes a base64 or percent-encoded data: URI into raw bytes.

nodes.name: parseBlobKey
nodes.summary: Parses and validates an OpenCode blob key into generation, part ID and kind.

nodes.name: detect.go
nodes.summary: Read-only detection of OpenCode storage generations (v2/v1 SQLite, legacy JSON tree) and the list of paths to watch.

nodes.name: Detect
nodes.summary: Detect reports the generations of OpenCode session storage available under the configured root. Schema inspection reads only allowlisted session table names; credentials are never opened or queried.

nodes.name: detectDB
nodes.summary: Opens the OpenCode SQLite store read-only and reports which known session tables (v1/v2) exist.

nodes.name: hasLegacySessions
nodes.summary: hasLegacySessions looks only at JSON session files one level below storage/session. Other legacy storage trees are not proof of session data.

nodes.name: WatchPaths
nodes.summary: WatchPaths returns only already-existing store paths. M2 also watches parent directories to discover paths created after this call.

nodes.name: load_v1.go
nodes.summary: Loads a full OpenCode v1 SQLite session into a model.Transcript, decoding message/part JSON, tool states, task children and retry metadata.

nodes.name: loadV1
nodes.summary: Reads a v1 session's messages and parts in order and builds the transcript, including tool calls, reasoning, files and task children.

nodes.name: childTables
nodes.summary: childTables probes once per load which session tables can confirm a task child's parent link, so childHasParent does not re-probe per child.

nodes.name: childHasParent
nodes.summary: Checks whether a task child session links back to the given parent session.

nodes.name: retryLine
nodes.summary: Formats a retry event part into a transcript metadata line.

nodes.name: load_v2.go
nodes.summary: OpenCode Load entry point: picks the v1 or v2 generation like Scan does, then streams v2 rows in one read-only transaction into a transcript with tokens, tools and outputs.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Load chooses the same generation as Scan: v2 wins unless a v1 duplicate has a strictly newer update time.

nodes.name: openV2
nodes.summary: Opens the OpenCode database read-only for a v2 load.

nodes.name: v2Ready
nodes.summary: Reports whether the v2 schema tables required for loading exist.

nodes.name: sessionUpdated
nodes.summary: Reads a session's update time from a generation table, used to pick the winning generation.

nodes.name: loadV2
nodes.summary: loadV2 streams ordered rows from the v2 store. The transaction supplied by Load fixes metadata, messages and child checks to one read-only snapshot.

nodes.name: safeKind
nodes.summary: Normalizes a v2 content kind to a known allowlisted value.

nodes.name: v2Tokens
nodes.summary: Converts v2 assistant token usage into model token counters.

nodes.name: v2ToolStatus
nodes.summary: Maps a v2 tool state string to the model's tool status.

nodes.name: v2Output
nodes.summary: Extracts a tool's output text and preview from v2 tool state.

nodes.name: outputPreview
nodes.summary: Truncates tool output to a bounded preview.

nodes.name: meta.go
nodes.summary: Applies generation-independent metadata finishing rules (first prompt, fallback title, origin) to scanned OpenCode session metas.

nodes.name: finishMetas
nodes.summary: finishMetas applies the generation-independent metadata rules after message counts have supplied FirstPrompt and, for untitled sessions, the latest user prompt with text as Title.

nodes.name: opencode.go
nodes.summary: Package root for the OpenCode provider: constructs the Provider and exposes its identity, resume/new-session commands, ACP adapter and unsupported-surface errors.

nodes.name: Provider
nodes.summary: Provider implements provider.Provider for OpenCode sessions.

nodes.name: unsupportedErr
nodes.summary: Error for provider surfaces owned by a later task, matching ErrUnsupported via Is.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: New constructs an OpenCode session provider rooted at root.

nodes.name: ID
nodes.summary: ID returns the model.AgentOpenCode identifier.

nodes.name: DisplayName
nodes.summary: DisplayName returns the human-readable provider name.

nodes.name: NewSessionCommand
nodes.summary: ResumeCommand returns the OpenCode CLI invocation that continues m. The app quotes argv and cwd for a shell; the provider never builds shell text.

nodes.name: ACPAdapter
nodes.summary: ACPAdapter runs OpenCode's built-in ACP server.

nodes.name: ResumeCommand
nodes.summary: Returns the OpenCode CLI argv and cwd that resume a session.

nodes.name: scan.go
nodes.summary: Incremental OpenCode Scan: reads every SQLite generation in a snapshot transaction, merges duplicate IDs by update time and persists a JSON checkpoint cursor.

nodes.name: membership
nodes.summary: Builds the per-generation ID membership used to detect generation changes.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Scan reads every available SQLite generation and merges duplicate IDs. A v2 row wins unless the v1 row was updated strictly later.

nodes.name: decodeCheckpoint
nodes.summary: Decodes and validates the JSON scan checkpoint stored in SourceState.

nodes.name: scanDBGenerations
nodes.summary: Scans the v1 and v2 generations inside one transaction, selecting new or updated IDs and collecting their metadata.

nodes.name: generationUpdatedIDs
nodes.summary: Lists IDs in a generation table updated at or after a cursor.

nodes.name: scan_v1.go
nodes.summary: SQL queries that list session IDs, metadata and message/token counts from the OpenCode v1 schema, tolerating optional columns of older versions.

nodes.name: v1IDs
nodes.summary: Lists all session IDs in the v1 session table.

nodes.name: v1Metas
nodes.summary: v1Metas selects either rows at or past the scan cursor or a bounded ID set. agent/model (added in 1.14.34) and cost/tokens (added in 1.14.49) are optional expressions because older OpenCode 1.x schemas lack them.

nodes.name: v1Counts
nodes.summary: Computes per-session message counts, first prompt, latest user prompt and token totals for v1 sessions in batches.

nodes.name: mergeIDLists
nodes.summary: Merges and deduplicates sorted ID lists.

nodes.name: scan_v2.go
nodes.summary: SQL queries that list session IDs, metadata and counts from the OpenCode v2 schema in batches, plus model-name parsing helpers.

nodes.name: v2Query
nodes.summary: Minimal query interface over a read-only transaction used by v2 scan queries.

nodes.name: v2IDs
nodes.summary: Lists all session IDs in the v2 session table.

nodes.name: v2Metas
nodes.summary: v2Metas can select either rows past a cursor or a bounded list of new IDs. Each batch of message queries is parameterized and never reads attachment data or materializes assistant JSON in Go.

nodes.name: v2Counts
nodes.summary: Computes per-session message counts, prompts and token totals for v2 sessions in parameterized batches.

nodes.name: parseModelName
nodes.summary: Extracts a provider/model display name from v2 model JSON.

nodes.name: turn.go
nodes.summary: Derives each OpenCode session's turn state (user turn, waiting on tool, done) from its last message in v1 or v2 stores.

nodes.name: lastMessageTurn
nodes.summary: lastMessageTurn is where a turn stands after a session's last message: a user prompt starts one; an assistant message with a tool pending or running waits on it (OpenCode runs a tool while it asks for permission); one that failed, or finished for any reason but more tool calls, ends it.

nodes.name: v1Turns
nodes.summary: v1Turns sets each session's Turn from its last user or assistant message and that message's tool parts.

nodes.name: v2Turns
nodes.summary: v2Turns does what v1Turns does for the v2 store, where tool calls are items of the assistant message's content.

nodes.name: scanTurns
nodes.summary: Runs the generation-specific turn query and applies turn states to session metas.

nodes.name: provider.go
nodes.summary: Core provider contract: the Provider interface plus Detection, ScanState/ScanResult, Command, ACP adapter, source-loader and live-detection types.

nodes.name: Detection
nodes.summary: Detection reports whether an agent's storage is present on this machine.

nodes.name: SourceState
nodes.summary: SourceState is the provider's resume point for one source (file or DB).

nodes.name: ScanState
nodes.summary: ScanState tracks scanner progress across sources.

nodes.name: ScanResult
nodes.summary: ScanResult reports sessions changed or removed since previous scan.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Command is an executable command line with working directory.

nodes.name: Provider
nodes.summary: Provider discovers and loads sessions for a specific agent.

nodes.name: ACPAdapter
nodes.summary: ACPAdapter describes how to start an agent's ACP server: a program found the way the agent CLIs are, or the app's own copy when Managed names one and the user approved its install (docs/plan/acp-adapter-install.md).

nodes.name: ACPLauncher
nodes.summary: ACPLauncher is implemented by providers whose agent can be driven over the Agent Client Protocol.

nodes.name: SourceLoader
nodes.summary: SourceLoader optionally loads using canonical scan metadata as an untrusted hint. See LoadWithSource for validation, fallback and metadata ownership rules.

nodes.name: SourceBlobLoader
nodes.summary: SourceBlobLoader is the independent Blob counterpart of SourceLoader. Source validation does not replace blob-key validation or authorize external content.

nodes.name: LiveDetector
nodes.summary: LiveDetector is an optional interface for providers supporting live session detection.

nodes.name: LiveInfo
nodes.summary: LiveInfo describes the live status of an active session.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Get returns the provider with the specified AgentID, if present.

nodes.name: barrier.go
nodes.summary: Test helper that wraps a provider so each Load blocks until the test explicitly replies, forwards or cancels it, enabling deterministic concurrency tests.

nodes.name: LoadAttempt
nodes.summary: LoadAttempt is one blocked load. Tests receive Started, then release individual attempts in any order with Reply or Forward, at most once per attempt.

nodes.name: LoadReply
nodes.summary: LoadReply is the result a test supplies for one LoadAttempt.

nodes.name: Barrier
nodes.summary: Barrier embeds a provider for non-load methods. Each Load announces itself and waits for an explicit reply or cancellation; there are no sleep-based gates.

nodes.name: IncrementalBarrier
nodes.summary: IncrementalBarrier is a Barrier that also implements provider.IncrementalLoader. Each LoadIncremental announces its Prev; Forward continues it with the wrapped provider, falling back to a full rebuild as provider.LoadIncremental does.

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.summary: Reply completes the attempt with tr and err without calling the wrapped provider. An incremental attempt publishes tr as a stateless full rebuild.

nodes.name: ReplyIncremental
nodes.summary: ReplyIncremental completes an incremental attempt with result and err.

nodes.name: Forward
nodes.summary: Forward releases the attempt to the embedded provider using the attempt context.

nodes.name: NewBarrier
nodes.summary: NewBarrier wraps p. capacity bounds how many announced attempts may be queued before a Load waits for the test to receive from Started.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close releases every blocked load with context.Canceled. It is idempotent.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Load counts the call, announces it on Started and waits for its release.

nodes.name: wait
nodes.summary: Announces a load attempt and blocks until the test replies, forwards it, or the context is cancelled.

nodes.name: NewIncrementalBarrier
nodes.summary: NewIncrementalBarrier wraps p like NewBarrier.

nodes.name: LoadIncremental
nodes.summary: LoadIncremental counts the call, announces it with prev and waits for its release.

nodes.name: fake.go
nodes.summary: Configurable fake Provider for tests with canned scan, load, blob and live responses and optional artificial latency.

nodes.name: Fake
nodes.summary: Fake is a test provider with configurable responses and artificial latency.

nodes.name: NewFake
nodes.summary: NewFake returns a Fake provider initialized with basic defaults.

nodes.name: ID
nodes.summary: Returns the fake's agent ID.

nodes.name: DisplayName
nodes.summary: Returns the fake's display name.

nodes.name: Detect
nodes.summary: Returns the configured detection result.

nodes.name: Scan
nodes.summary: Returns configured scan results after optional latency, honoring cancellation.

nodes.name: Load
nodes.summary: Returns the configured transcript or error for a session ref.

nodes.name: Blob
nodes.summary: Returns the configured blob bytes for a key.

nodes.name: WatchPaths
nodes.summary: Returns the configured watch paths.

nodes.name: ResumeCommand
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic resume command for a session.

nodes.name: NewSessionCommand
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic new-session command.

nodes.name: Live
nodes.summary: Returns configured live session info.

nodes.name: incremental.go
nodes.summary: Harness that checks incremental transcript loads against cold loads over a sequence of source snapshots, verifying equivalence and snapshot immutability.

nodes.name: IncrementalHarness
nodes.summary: IncrementalHarness checks a sequence of source snapshots against cold loads. Callers control the source explicitly, so it works with files, sidecars and metadata-only changes.

nodes.name: Check
nodes.summary: Check loads the current source incrementally and cold, checking equivalence, the earliest changed index, and all earlier snapshots' immutability.

nodes.name: CheckImmutable
nodes.summary: CheckImmutable can also be called after failed or cancelled loads.

nodes.name: FirstMessageDifference
nodes.summary: FirstMessageDifference is the common-prefix length, including append-only and truncation cases. It deliberately compares all nested data.

nodes.name: CloneTranscript
nodes.summary: CloneTranscript preserves nil/empty distinctions by recursively copying slices and pointer targets rather than going through the omitempty JSON wire shape.

nodes.name: transcript.go
nodes.summary: Generates synthetic Claude or Codex JSONL transcript fixtures of a target size and appends live records, for provider tests and benchmarks.

nodes.name: TranscriptFixture
nodes.summary: TranscriptFixture writes one valid Claude or Codex transcript below tb.TempDir and returns a provider rooted there. targetBytes (decimal MB × 1,000,000) sets only the user prompt length, so the file is slightly larger than the target; targetBytes 0 gives the small equivalent with identical IDs an...

nodes.name: TranscriptProvider
nodes.summary: TranscriptProvider returns a Claude or Codex provider rooted at root.

nodes.name: TranscriptRef
nodes.summary: TranscriptRef is the reference of a generated transcript with session ID id.

nodes.name: TranscriptPath
nodes.summary: TranscriptPath is where WriteTranscript puts session id below root.

nodes.name: WriteTranscript
nodes.summary: WriteTranscript writes the TranscriptFixture content for session id below root and returns its path. Several sessions may share one root.

nodes.name: TranscriptTurnRecords
nodes.summary: TranscriptTurnRecords is the number of JSONL records in one generated turn.

nodes.name: transcriptTurn
nodes.summary: transcriptTurn renders turn i: a user prompt, a split assistant message with a tool call, and the call's completed result.

nodes.name: AppendTranscriptRecords
nodes.summary: AppendTranscriptRecords appends exactly n complete records, starting at turn first. A partial final turn is intentional: live updates arrive record by record.

nodes.name: TranscriptEstimate
nodes.summary: TranscriptEstimate is an intentionally approximate shallow-layout + content byte estimate, NOT a heap measurement. It excludes allocator rounding, metadata strings, sharing, parser temporaries, maps and GC/runtime overhead.

nodes.name: scanwork.go
nodes.summary: Opt-in context-scoped ScanWork counters describing logical scanner work for synthetic benchmarks.

nodes.name: ScanWork
nodes.summary: ScanWork is opt-in diagnostic accounting for synthetic scan benchmarks. Counters describe logical scanner work, not OS reads, filesystem cache misses or bytes fetched by discovery/index/sidecar inspection.

nodes.name: WithScanWork
nodes.summary: WithScanWork attaches a concurrency-safe collector to this scan only. Ordinary scans have no collector; there is no global hook or persisted schema change.

nodes.name: ScanWorkFromContext
nodes.summary: ScanWorkFromContext returns the optional collector for provider scan internals.

nodes.name: source.go
nodes.summary: LoadWithSource and BlobWithSource helpers that use a provider's optional source-aware loaders with a single standalone fallback on stale sources.

nodes.name: LoadWithSource
nodes.summary: LoadWithSource uses optional source loading, with at most one standalone Load fallback on ErrStaleSource. The base Provider and remote protocols are unchanged.

nodes.name: BlobWithSource
nodes.summary: BlobWithSource follows LoadWithSource's validation and bounded fallback rules. A blob key remains provider-defined and must be validated independently.

nodes.name: db.go
nodes.summary: Opens agent SQLite stores strictly read-only and probes allowlisted tables and columns for providers.

nodes.name: Open
nodes.summary: Open opens an existing SQLite database read-only. The caller must Close the returned DB.

nodes.name: HasTable
nodes.summary: HasTable reports whether a known provider table exists. The table name is a bound value, not SQL syntax; unknown names are rejected even so.

nodes.name: Columns
nodes.summary: Columns reports the columns of a known provider table. A missing table has no columns.

nodes.name: builder.go
nodes.summary: Copy-on-write message Builder for transcript parsers: one writer appends/touches messages while frozen immutable snapshots are shared with readers.

nodes.name: ToolLoc
nodes.summary: ToolLoc identifies a tool without retaining a pointer into a frozen snapshot.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.summary: Builder owns messages supplied to Append. Callers must not retain mutable pointers across Freeze or Fork, or mutate Append's input after transferring it.

nodes.name: Len
nodes.summary: Len is the current message count.

nodes.name: At
nodes.summary: At returns a read-only message value; its nested storage must not be mutated.

nodes.name: Append
nodes.summary: Append transfers ownership of msg and returns its index.

nodes.name: Touch
nodes.summary: Touch returns a writable message, deeply detaching nested storage on the first touch of a frozen message. The top-level array is copied at most once per freeze.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: Tool detaches and returns the tool at loc. Invalid locations panic, like Touch.

nodes.name: Freeze
nodes.summary: Freeze publishes a clipped immutable snapshot and the earliest changed index. No changes gives Len().

nodes.name: Changed
nodes.summary: Changed is the earliest index changed since the last Freeze, or Len() if none.

nodes.name: Bytes
nodes.summary: Bytes is the sum of message weights at the last Freeze. It excludes transcript metadata and spare capacity of the top-level message array.

nodes.name: Overhead
nodes.summary: Overhead estimates storage a snapshot never exposes: the weight table and spare capacity of the top-level message array.

nodes.name: Fork
nodes.summary: Fork creates an independent writer over the current snapshot. It freezes the original first; both writers subsequently copy touched messages.

nodes.name: cloneMessage
nodes.summary: Deep-copies a message's nested storage so a touched message no longer shares memory with frozen snapshots.

nodes.name: unshared.go
nodes.summary: Estimates memory a committed transcript retains beyond a forked published snapshot by detecting shared storage by identity.

nodes.name: Unshared
nodes.summary: Unshared estimates storage that committed retains beyond published, a snapshot forked from it: the message array and nested content the fork replaced.

nodes.name: retainedParts

nodes.name: JSONBytes

nodes.name: sshEnvironment

nodes.name: catalog.go

nodes.name: Catalog
nodes.summary: Catalog is a concurrency-safe snapshot of the sessions found by providers.

nodes.name: NewCatalog
nodes.summary: Creates an empty Catalog.

nodes.name: Apply
nodes.summary: Apply removes old sessions before upserting changed sessions.

nodes.name: Remove
nodes.summary: Remove deletes the given sessions without affecting other catalog entries.

nodes.name: Reset
nodes.summary: Reset clears all sessions from the catalog and replaces them with metas.

nodes.name: ApplyLive
nodes.summary: ApplyLive updates the catalog with scan results and overlays live badges. It returns the sessions the scan left unchanged whose badge changed.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies a scan result's removals and upserts under the catalog lock.

nodes.name: applyLive
nodes.summary: applyLive makes the scan result and its live overlay visible atomically. A failed live call keeps the badges from the previous scan, even for sessions the scan just changed; a successful call re-derives every badge of this provider from the live map, including for unchanged sessions; those whose ...

nodes.name: All
nodes.summary: All returns a sorted, independent snapshot of every session.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Get returns the metadata for one session, if it exists.

nodes.name: Children
nodes.summary: Children returns sessions whose parent belongs to the same provider.

nodes.name: sortSessions
nodes.summary: Sorts sessions by recency and key for stable snapshots.

nodes.name: detection.go

nodes.name: DiscoveryObserver

nodes.name: WithDiscoveryObserver
nodes.summary: WithDiscoveryObserver attaches o to one discovery pass's context.

nodes.name: ObserveDetection
nodes.summary: ObserveDetection records one provider's detection result, if observed.

nodes.name: ObserveScan
nodes.summary: ObserveScan records one detected provider's scan result, if observed.

nodes.name: scan.go

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Runner scans providers concurrently and applies results to a catalog. Do not call Run concurrently on the same Runner.

nodes.name: Report
nodes.summary: Report aggregates the outcome of a run over all providers.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Run scans each detected provider. Failed and absent providers retain their previous state and catalog entries until a successful scan replaces them.

nodes.name: RunWithOnApplied
nodes.summary: RunWithOnApplied is Run with a per-pass notification after each successful catalog application and report update (including successful empty results).

nodes.name: watch.go
nodes.summary: Filesystem watcher that turns provider storage changes into debounced, coalesced Change notifications, with recursive roots, anchors for missing paths and polling fallback with backoff.

nodes.name: Change
nodes.summary: Change identifies one provider's changed sources. Paths is nil when a full reconciliation is required (polling, a directory topology change, or a watcher error).

nodes.name: Watcher
nodes.summary: Watcher owns provider watches, debounce state, and reconciliation polling.

nodes.name: providerState
nodes.summary: Per-provider watch state: roots, owned directories, pending changes, fallback and retry bookkeeping.

nodes.name: fsWatcher
nodes.summary: Interface over fsnotify used by the Watcher, allowing test substitution.

nodes.name: nativeWatcher
nodes.summary: Adapter exposing fsnotify.Watcher channels through the fsWatcher interface.

nodes.name: WithIntervals
nodes.summary: WithIntervals overrides debounce and polling intervals. A zero duration retains the corresponding production default.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Start begins watching provider storage. The callback is serialized by a single dispatcher; it must return promptly.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: New constructs an unstarted Watcher. Use Start to bind its lifetime to a context.

nodes.name: Watcher.Start
nodes.summary: Starts the watcher once, binding its lifetime to a context; a cancelled parent context shuts it down.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close stops all watches and polling. It is idempotent and waits until no callback from this watcher can start.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main event loop: dispatches fsnotify events and errors, wake signals and timers until shutdown.

nodes.name: handleEvent
nodes.summary: Classifies a filesystem event, updating watched trees and queueing the owning providers' changed paths.

nodes.name: handleError
nodes.summary: handleError handles an error from the filesystem watcher. An overflow lost events but kept every watch: each provider is rescanned in full.

nodes.name: failAll
nodes.summary: failAll moves every provider to polling. broken means the filesystem watcher itself is gone, so watches are not tried again.

nodes.name: retryWatchesLocked
nodes.summary: retryWatchesLocked tries the watches of a provider in fallback again. On success it leaves fallback, with a full rescan for what changed meanwhile; on failure setFallbackLocked schedules the next try, later.

nodes.name: nextRetryDelay
nodes.summary: nextRetryDelay is how long a provider that just fell back waits before trying its watches again: the fallback poll interval, doubled on each failure in a row up to retryBackoffLimit times it.

nodes.name: installRootLocked
nodes.summary: Installs a watch for one provider root, recursively or via its parent, or an anchor if it does not exist yet.

nodes.name: rootCreatedLocked
nodes.summary: rootCreatedLocked installs each root at or below a directory that just appeared, and rescans once one exists.

nodes.name: reinstallRootsUnderLocked
nodes.summary: reinstallRootsUnderLocked installs again each root at or below a removed path, so a missing root gets its anchor.

nodes.name: addAnchorLocked
nodes.summary: addAnchorLocked watches dir as an anchor for state.

nodes.name: addTreeLocked
nodes.summary: Recursively watches a directory tree for a provider.

nodes.name: addDirLocked
nodes.summary: Watches one directory for a provider and records ownership.

nodes.name: watchPathLocked
nodes.summary: watchPathLocked adds path to the filesystem watcher and records state as one of its owners.

nodes.name: forgetTreeLocked
nodes.summary: Drops watches for a removed directory tree.

nodes.name: disownLocked
nodes.summary: disownLocked drops state as an owner of path, unless state still watches it as a root directory or an anchor.

nodes.name: ownersLocked
nodes.summary: Returns the provider states that own a watched path.

nodes.name: setFallbackLocked
nodes.summary: setFallbackLocked moves state to polling after err, drops its watches and, while the filesystem watcher works, schedules a try to watch again.

nodes.name: queueLocked
nodes.summary: Queues changed paths (or a full rescan) for a provider with debounce.

nodes.name: dispatchDue
nodes.summary: Delivers due coalesced Change notifications to the callback, including polling rescans.

nodes.name: nextDelay
nodes.summary: Computes when the next debounce, poll or retry is due.

nodes.name: relevantEvent
nodes.summary: Filters out events irrelevant to provider sources (e.g. chmod or unrelated files).

nodes.name: rootsFor
nodes.summary: Derives watch roots from a provider's watch paths, watching parents of database files.

nodes.name: absoluteClean
nodes.summary: Returns an absolute, cleaned path.

nodes.name: nearestExistingDir
nodes.summary: Finds the closest existing ancestor directory of a path for anchoring.
