nodes.summary: Quits after window approval, installs the downloaded update and starts the new version.

nodes.name: watchUpdates
nodes.summary: Forwards update status changes to this window's frontend.

nodes.name: update_darwin.go
nodes.summary: macOS self-update wiring: detects whether the signed app bundle can replace itself, stages and verifies downloads beside it, and starts the swap helper on exit.

nodes.name: macInstall
nodes.summary: Determines once, via codesign, whether the running macOS app bundle can replace itself.

nodes.name: macPrepare
nodes.summary: Unpacks and verifies a downloaded app beside the installed one.

nodes.name: update_linux.go
nodes.summary: Linux update wiring that sets the install-method detector used by the updater.

nodes.name: code_diagnostics.go
nodes.summary: Wails-bound App methods exposing the Stage 1 code diagnostics API (attach, snapshot, approve, revoke, run, cancel, detach, invalidate, logs) to the frontend, routing each call through a host-identity and connection-epoch guard to the active engine backend.

nodes.name: code_diagnostics_documents.go
nodes.summary: App methods for live code diagnostics: open/change/save/close of editor documents plus LSP navigation (definition, references, hover) and read-only external file viewing, all routed through the live backend surface.

nodes.name: code_diagnostics_offline.go
nodes.summary: Stub implementation of the code diagnostics backend for a disconnected host: every method fails with a 'disconnected' error so UI calls fail closed.

nodes.name: managed_tools.go
nodes.summary: App method that forwards a managed tool (download/install) request to the active backend after a host-epoch check; the request carries only closed tool IDs and opaque consent/job IDs.

nodes.name: diagnosticsRoute
nodes.summary: diagnosticsRoute validates the stable backend identity, not the SSH alias used by file editing. Optional support fails closed until CD-09 negotiates it.

nodes.name: AttachCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: AttachCodeDiagnostics leaves the disabled languages (turned off in Settings) out of discovery on hosts that support it; others check every language.

nodes.name: GetCodeDiagnosticsSnapshot
nodes.summary: Returns the current diagnostics snapshot for a context after routing to the expected backend host.

nodes.name: ApproveCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Approves the proposed tool fingerprint for a project in the given mode on the routed backend.

nodes.name: RevokeCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Revokes a project's code diagnostics approval on the routed backend.

nodes.name: RunCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Starts checker runs for the selected provider IDs on the routed backend.

nodes.name: CancelCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Cancels the given checker runs on the routed backend.

nodes.name: DetachCodeDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Detaches a diagnostics attachment from the routed backend.

nodes.name: InvalidateCodeDiagnosticsPath
nodes.summary: Invalidates diagnostics for a changed or deleted path on the routed backend and returns the new snapshot.

nodes.name: OpenCodeDiagnosticDocument
nodes.summary: Opens an editor document with its displayed text on the live diagnostics route.

nodes.name: ChangeCodeDiagnosticDocument
nodes.summary: Sends the full new text of an open document at a new version on the live route.

nodes.name: SaveCodeDiagnosticDocument
nodes.summary: Reports a completed editor save of a document version on the live route.

nodes.name: CloseCodeDiagnosticDocument
nodes.summary: Closes an open live document on the routed backend.

nodes.name: NavigateCode
nodes.summary: NavigateCode asks the language server that holds a live document about the symbol at position: op is definition, references or hover. It goes over the same route as the document operations.

nodes.name: ReadNavigationFile
nodes.summary: ReadNavigationFile reads, for viewing only, an external file (absolute host path) that a navigation answer of the same attachment pointed to.

nodes.name: ManagedTool
nodes.summary: ManagedTool is an optional, host-epoch checked operation. The request contains only the closed tool ID and opaque consent/job IDs, never installer policy.

nodes.name: capture.go
nodes.summary: Bounded stdout/stderr capture for checker processes: accounts raw bytes across both streams, enforces per-line limits and never blocks writers.

nodes.name: cargo_check.go
nodes.summary: Saved-file checker adapter that runs `cargo check` with JSON output for approved Rust workspaces, reusing the metadata-only Rust discovery and leasing approved tools before execution.

nodes.name: cargo_check_parse.go
nodes.summary: Parser for cargo's line-delimited JSON compiler messages, converting rustc spans to byte-accurate positions and refusing inline coordinates when span text disagrees with disk.

nodes.name: check_failure.go
nodes.summary: Local failure reporting for checker and preparation runs: sanitized, bounded output excerpts written only to the owner's on-disk log, never to snapshots or the UI.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: io.Writer implementation that accounts bytes, splits lines and enforces per-stream line limits without blocking.

nodes.name: CargoCheckPlan
nodes.summary: Checker adapter holding the authorized root, Rust discovery, cargo commands and tool proposal for cargo check.

nodes.name: DiscoverCargoCheck
nodes.summary: Discovers the Rust workspace and builds a CargoCheckPlan from it.

nodes.name: NewCargoCheckPlan
nodes.summary: NewCargoCheckPlan reuses the metadata-only discovery shared with live analysis.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.summary: Returns the cargo check approval tool proposal.

nodes.name: RunApproved
nodes.summary: Runs cargo check per workspace root under the supervisor with an approved lease and parses the JSON messages into a CheckerResult.

nodes.name: parseCargoCheck
nodes.summary: Cargo emits one JSON object per line, including an explicit terminal outcome. A failed build is a complete compiler result only with compiler errors and exit 101.

nodes.name: cargoSpanTextMatches
nodes.summary: rustc carries the source lines used to produce a span. Refuse inline coordinates when those disagree with disk, while retaining the contained panel message.

nodes.name: CheckFailure
nodes.summary: CheckFailure is the local log report of one failed checker or preparation run.

nodes.name: ReportOutput
nodes.summary: ReportOutput is the sanitized start and end of one output stream.

nodes.name: BoundOutput
nodes.summary: BoundOutput keeps the sanitized start and end of b for a local log.

nodes.name: ReportFailure
nodes.summary: ReportFailure logs a run the checker rejects although the supervisor accepted it: unparseable output, unexpected stderr, an unsupported version.

nodes.name: report
nodes.summary: report hands the run to the owner's FailureLog, if any.

nodes.name: documents.go
nodes.summary: Manager side of live document synchronization: open/change/save/close lifecycles, ownership routing to approved LSP sessions, incremental diffs in UTF-16 coordinates and publication of per-document diagnostic sets.
nodes.languageNotes: Positions use UTF-16 code units per LSP, so byte offsets are converted carefully around CRLF and non-BMP runes.

nodes.name: fingerprint.go
nodes.summary: Computes approval fingerprints from bounded regular-file identities of tool executables and config, plus a separate in-process analyzer fingerprint, without executing anything.

nodes.name: go_build_context.go
nodes.summary: Reimplements go/build header and filename rules to infer which custom build tags make each Go file build under fixed host facts, used to assign files to gopls build contexts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses golang.org/x/... style go/build/constraint expressions and mirrors go/build matchTag/filename rules.

nodes.name: go_lsp.go
nodes.summary: gopls adapter: metadata-only discovery of the Go toolchain and workspace modules, build-context inference, registration, and a bridge that normalizes LSP publishDiagnostics into document-set replacements.

nodes.name: DocumentReceipt
nodes.summary: DocumentReceipt is the only result of a document operation: identity, never text.

nodes.name: DocumentChange
nodes.summary: DocumentChange is one ordered edit of the session's copy of a document. Ranges are zero-based UTF-16 positions with exclusive end. A nil Range is the whole document.

nodes.name: DocumentStep
nodes.summary: DocumentStep is one ordered synchronization notification. didSave never has a body; didClose has neither. Text is only set for open and full sync.

nodes.name: DocumentProvider
nodes.summary: DocumentProvider is the host-local seam to approved language sessions. It never starts a process: a missing/stale session is reported as an error. Implementations must not log or retain text.

nodes.name: DocumentOwnerIdentity
nodes.summary: DocumentOwnerIdentity is backend-resolved, never client or diagnostic input. Policy binds the exact fixed server configuration, independently of generation.

nodes.name: OwnedDocumentProvider
nodes.summary: OwnedDocumentProvider augments the legacy synchronization seam. Live operations fail closed without it: a generation alone cannot establish provider ownership.

nodes.name: DocumentSession
nodes.summary: DocumentSession is one independently owned synchronization route. Err is per provider so an unavailable peer cannot suppress a healthy session.

nodes.name: MultiOwnedDocumentProvider
nodes.summary: Document provider interface that can report several independently owned sessions for one path.

nodes.name: documentSessions
nodes.summary: Lists the validated owning sessions for a path, falling back to a single owner and failing closed on unbounded or duplicate owners.

nodes.name: SetDocumentProvider
nodes.summary: SetDocumentProvider installs the session seam. Without one every document operation fails with unsupported before any process or state exists.

nodes.name: docStep
nodes.summary: Applies one document synchronization step through the provider and marks the document broken on failure.

nodes.name: OpenDocument
nodes.summary: OpenDocument registers actual displayed text under a fresh documentId and sends didOpen to the approved session. The mirror exists only to compute the negotiated incremental edit and to detect an idempotent repeat.

nodes.name: ownedDocument
nodes.summary: Looks up the attachment and live document state for a document ID, rejecting closed or unknown identities.

nodes.name: ChangeDocument
nodes.summary: ChangeDocument takes full displayed text. Versions strictly increase. The same version with identical text is idempotent; different text conflicts.

nodes.name: changeDocumentRoute
nodes.summary: Sends a change for one owning session, computing an incremental or full-sync edit from the mirror.

nodes.name: SaveDocument
nodes.summary: SaveDocument reports that an editor save of savedVersion completed. It has no body and performs no file write.

nodes.name: saveDocumentRoute
nodes.summary: Sends didSave for one owning session when the saved version matches the live mirror.

nodes.name: CloseDocument
nodes.summary: CloseDocument ends one lifecycle deterministically: owned live results are removed first, the identity is rejected afterwards, then didClose is sent best-effort. A repeated close of a closed identity is idempotent.

nodes.name: dropDocument
nodes.summary: dropDocument removes the registry entry and its LSP result set and remembers recent identities in a bounded FIFO. Wire lifecycle isolation must not rely on this history: it is owned independently by the server transport.

nodes.name: releaseDocuments
nodes.summary: releaseDocuments drops every document of an attachment (detach, revoke, invalidation). didClose is best-effort and runs outside the owner lock.

nodes.name: PublishDocumentResults
nodes.summary: PublishDocumentResults replaces exactly one open document's LSP set (empty included). The explicit identity, bound owner/policy, session generation and version must match.

nodes.name: publishPathDiagnostics
nodes.summary: Finds the open document for a path in the owning attachment and verifies provider ownership before replacing its LSP results.

nodes.name: publishLocked
nodes.summary: Replaces a document's diagnostic set for one provider under the manager lock after checking generation and version.

nodes.name: positionOf
nodes.summary: positionOf converts a byte offset (not inside CRLF or a rune) to line and UTF-16 column. CR/LF contribute no column; non-BMP characters count as two.

nodes.name: coordinateInText
nodes.summary: Reports whether a UTF-16 line/character position lies inside the given text.

nodes.name: diffChange
nodes.summary: diffChange returns the single ordered edit turning old into new. Boundaries are moved off rune and CRLF interiors so positions are always valid.

nodes.name: ToolInput
nodes.summary: ToolInput is fixed adapter-owned metadata, never arbitrary client commands. Policy includes the adapter version, fixed argv policy, environment allowlist values, toolchain selectors and dependency identity policy.

nodes.name: Fingerprint
nodes.summary: Fingerprint reads only bounded regular-file identities; it does not run --version, load plugins or evaluate configuration. All inputs must be verifiable now.

nodes.name: InProcessFingerprint
nodes.summary: InProcessFingerprint is the approval identity of a proposal that contains only in-process analyzers and no executable.

nodes.name: identifyFile
nodes.summary: Stats and hashes one bounded regular file (optionally rooted) into a file identity for the fingerprint.

nodes.name: goVersionFileName
nodes.summary: 8", or "" when the file is missing or unreadable.

nodes.name: parseGoVersionMinor
nodes.summary: P|rcX|betaX]" first line.

nodes.name: readGoBuildPrefix
nodes.summary: readGoBuildPrefix reads r only until the file's package clause line is complete, never more than maxGoBuildHeaderBytes. It returns that prefix, which parseGoBuildHeader accepts.

nodes.name: scanGoBuildHeader
nodes.summary: scanGoBuildHeader mirrors go/build's header rules (parseFileHeader) and additionally requires the first non-comment text to be a package clause.

nodes.name: scanGoBuildPackageName
nodes.summary: scanGoBuildPackageName verifies the first declaration line is a valid `package <ident>` clause, using go/scanner's own lexing. A line that was cut off by the end of data is only accepted once it names a package.

nodes.name: plusBuildLines
nodes.summary: plusBuildLines are the legacy lines go/build honours: only inside the comment block that ends at the last blank line before the package clause.

nodes.name: parseGoBuildHeader
nodes.summary: parseGoBuildHeader returns the file's build expression from a prefix that reaches the package clause. A nil expression with a nil error is a valid unconstrained header.

nodes.name: goBuildExprWithinBounds
nodes.summary: goBuildExprWithinBounds checks depth and total node count.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: classify mirrors go/build's matchTag for the fixed facts. Reserved names are never custom: they are either decided by the fixed facts or unknown.

nodes.name: matchesGoFileName
nodes.summary: matchesGoFileName applies go/build's filename GOOS/GOARCH rules, including the _test suffix and platform aliases. It reports false for files go ignores.

nodes.name: inferGoBuildTags
nodes.summary: inferGoBuildTags decides which custom tags make the file at name (base name) with the given header prefix build under the fixed facts, for every possible value of the unknown reserved facts.

nodes.name: GoplsEnvironment
nodes.summary: GoplsEnvironment is reviewed host metadata, not the inherited environment.

nodes.name: GoplsPlan
nodes.summary: GoplsPlan is the discovery result. Availability is independent of every other provider: a missing or unsupported server never disables go vet.

nodes.name: GoplsBridge
nodes.summary: GoplsBridge turns session notifications into document-set replacements. Notifications to Handle. It publishes nothing for unopened, closed or out-of-root files and never creates document state.

nodes.name: DiscoverGopls
nodes.summary: DiscoverGopls inspects metadata only. Errors are reserved for an invalid host description or a root that is no longer authorized; everything about the tool or project is reported as plan availability.

nodes.name: isExecutable
nodes.summary: Reports whether a path is a regular executable file.

nodes.name: Provider
nodes.summary: Provider describes honest opened-documents coverage. DiscoverLocalLive registers it for the desktop local live route (experimental), and neither successful initialization nor an empty publication is reported as clean Go.

nodes.name: Registration
nodes.summary: Registration keeps semantic gopls identity while exposing exclusive owners for at most four host contexts. Contexts never accumulate tags from other files.

nodes.name: validGoContextID
nodes.summary: Validates the format of a Go build-context identifier.

nodes.name: inferContexts
nodes.summary: Assigns covered Go sources to at most a few build contexts by inferring the custom tags each file needs.

nodes.name: validateContext
nodes.summary: Header membership is checked against the immutable discovery assignment, not used to mutate it. New/changed contexts require rediscovery and approval. This seam sees full displayed text, never client-supplied flags.

nodes.name: discoverGoWorkspace
nodes.summary: discoverGoWorkspace walks only inside the authorized root with bounded, rooted reads, files before folders, leaving out folders Git ignores (gitScope).

nodes.name: normalizeLSPPublication
nodes.summary: normalizeLSPPublication is the provider-agnostic body shared with the TypeScript adapter (CD-23); providerID only prefixes diagnostic attribution.

nodes.name: normalizeLSPDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Converts one raw LSP diagnostic into a bounded internal Diagnostic attributed to the provider.

nodes.name: parseLSPRange
nodes.summary: Parses and validates an LSP range JSON value.

nodes.name: Handle
nodes.summary: Handle must be quick and runs on the session goroutine.

nodes.name: go_syntax.go
nodes.summary: In-process Go syntax checker owned by the project watcher: walks the contained project, parses Go files with go/parser, caches findings by size/mtime and tracks other saved-file transitions.

nodes.name: go_version.go
nodes.summary: Detects modules whose go directive requires a newer Go than the reviewed toolchain, since checkers run with GOTOOLCHAIN=local.

nodes.name: go_vet.go
nodes.summary: go vet checker adapter: metadata-only discovery of Go modules and toolchain, approval tool proposal, and approved execution under the supervisor with JSON output parsing.

nodes.name: go_vet_parse.go
nodes.summary: Wire types for positions, ranges and diagnostics plus a fail-closed parser for go vet's pretty-printed JSON output, mapping line/column locations to UTF-16 positions.

nodes.name: GoSyntaxLimits
nodes.summary: GoSyntaxLimits bound one scan. Zero values take the defaults; larger values are clamped to them.

nodes.name: GoSyntax
nodes.summary: GoSyntax is owned by exactly one goroutine (the project watcher loop). It keeps per-file findings only, never file bodies.

nodes.name: FileChange
nodes.summary: FileChange is one analyzed saved-file transition. Kind is 1 created, 2 changed, 3 deleted (the LSP FileChangeType values).

nodes.name: defaults
nodes.summary: Fills zero GoSyntaxLimits with defaults and clamps larger values.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: walk enumerates contained directories and owned files. Root.

nodes.name: Full
nodes.summary: Full walks and parses the whole contained project. Unchanged (size, mtime) files reuse cached findings; the cache is rebuilt so deletions drop out.

nodes.name: trackAll
nodes.summary: trackAll replaces the tracked files' sizes and times with the walk's and reports the transitions. Deletions are not claimed after a truncated walk.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Update re-reads only the given contained paths: owned Go files are parsed again, tracked files compared by size and time. Other and skipped paths are ignored. A missing file drops its findings.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: parse reads one bounded, contained file and converts syntax errors to UTF-16 ranges bound to the exact bytes' revision.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Assembles the current per-file findings into a CheckerResult.

nodes.name: HasGoSources
nodes.summary: HasGoSources is a bounded, metadata-only probe used during discovery.

nodes.name: goTooOld
nodes.summary: goTooOld explains the modules whose go directive needs a newer Go than the reviewed toolchain at goroot. Checkers run Go with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so Go refuses such a module rather than download the toolchain it asks for.

nodes.name: GoVetEnvironment
nodes.summary: GoVetEnvironment is reviewed host metadata, not inherited process environment. Cache directories may be written by Go; this adapter is not a sandbox.

nodes.name: GoVetPlan
nodes.summary: go vet checker adapter holding the root, environment, discovered modules, commands and tool proposal.

nodes.name: CheckerResult
nodes.summary: CheckerResult is a complete adapter outcome for the future manager. Replace must be false on ANY module/probe failure: retain the prior provider set stale.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.summary: Tools returns an approval proposal without executing even a version probe.

nodes.name: DiscoverGoVet
nodes.summary: DiscoverGoVet uses only bounded, rooted metadata/config reads. PATH is supplied by the host owner for review; relative PATH entries and shell launchers are ignored.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.summary: Walks the project for go.mod/go.work modules and toolchain metadata to build go vet commands.

nodes.name: RunApproved
nodes.summary: RunApproved uses the attachment-wide tool proposal for lease identity.

nodes.name: rootedRead
nodes.summary: Reads a bounded file through the authorized root without following escapes.

nodes.name: Position
nodes.summary: Type block declaring the wire types Position, Range, SavedBasis and Diagnostic shared by checkers and snapshots.

nodes.name: parseGoVet
nodes.summary: Consecutive pretty-printed objects, NOT NDJSON. Unknown shapes fail closed.

nodes.name: vetLocation
nodes.summary: Parse numeric suffixes from the right, preserving spaces and drive colons. A bare filename is a synthetic file-level location, not line 1.

nodes.name: bytePosition
nodes.summary: Converts a 1-based line and byte column into a UTF-16 Position within the file data.

nodes.name: grants.go
nodes.summary: Durable per-project approval grants stored under a cross-process config lock, and the Trust authority that approves, revokes, rebinds and preflights tool leases for one connection lifetime.

nodes.name: java_lsp.go
nodes.summary: Eclipse JDT LS adapter: discovers the jdtls distribution and Java runtime from reviewed paths, builds a bounded distribution manifest for approval identity and exposes the live provider.

nodes.name: languages.go
nodes.summary: Closed registry of supported languages grouping their providers and managed tools, with helpers to disable languages and report disabled registrations.

nodes.name: live_discovery.go
nodes.summary: Live language-server discovery: builds registrations for gopls, vtsls, Svelte, Ruff, Pyright, rust-analyzer, RuboCop, ruby-lsp, JDT LS and others, and binds them into SessionDocuments with validated ownership.

nodes.name: GrantStore
nodes.summary: toml. All reads and read/modify/writes take the same cross-process configfile lock.

nodes.name: Approval
nodes.summary: Result of an approval lookup: the grant kind and whether it is approved.

nodes.name: Trust
nodes.summary: Trust owns exactly one authenticated connection/app lifetime (including Local). Close MUST be called on disconnect/shutdown. Never reuse it on reconnect.

nodes.name: Lease
nodes.summary: Lease is a queued/running-work cancellation hook, not a process launch permit. Future manager/supervisor must validate immediately before spawn AND before publication, and observe Context for process-tree cancellation.

nodes.name: NewGrantStore
nodes.summary: Creates the dedicated grant store inside the config directory.

nodes.name: transaction
nodes.summary: Runs a read or read/modify/write on the grant file under the cross-process configfile lock.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.summary: lookup reports the project's grant kind if it covers fp of kind, carrying the record over to fp first when the fingerprint changed.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Records a grant of the given kind for a project fingerprint.

nodes.name: approve
nodes.summary: Recomputes the proposal identity under the trust lock and records the grant if it matches.

nodes.name: Rebind
nodes.summary: Rebind carries a single current lease over planned setup outputs. The caller validates outputs; this method checks the exact epoch and old durable grant.

nodes.name: Revoke
nodes.summary: Revoke invalidates generation BEFORE cancellation and durable removal. Even if the disk write fails, this owner remains revoked and its leases are dead.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Invalidates the trust authority and all its leases on disconnect or shutdown.

nodes.name: Preflight
nodes.summary: Validates the current grant for a tool set and issues a cancellable Lease.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Validate also rehashes identity and rechecks the durable grant, not just epoch.

nodes.name: JavaEnvironment
nodes.summary: JavaEnvironment contains reviewed absolute host paths, not inherited variables. Cache is the app-owned cache base. JavaHome optionally pins a JDK installation.

nodes.name: JavaPlan
nodes.summary: Java discovery result holding availability, versions, projects and the jdtls server configuration.

nodes.name: discoverJavaWorkspace
nodes.summary: Scans for Java build projects, resolves the jdtls distribution and Java runtime, and builds the server config and approval tools.

nodes.name: resolveJavaDistribution
nodes.summary: Resolve only reviewed layout hints, never arbitrary wrapper contents.

nodes.name: resolveJavaRuntime
nodes.summary: Finds the java executable from JAVA home or reviewed PATH directories.

nodes.name: javaNative
nodes.summary: Reports whether a file is a native executable rather than a script wrapper.

nodes.name: javaReleaseVersion
nodes.summary: Reads the Java major version from a JDK release file.

nodes.name: javaCachePath
nodes.summary: Canonicalize the existing portion, leaving missing suffixes uncreated.

nodes.name: javaApprovalConfigs
nodes.summary: Collects bounded project build config files bound into the Java approval.

nodes.name: javaIdentityPaths
nodes.summary: Enumerates distribution files that make up the jdtls identity.

nodes.name: javaDistributionManifest
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded manifest of jdtls distribution files for identity checks.

nodes.name: unchanged
nodes.summary: Verifies the jdtls distribution files have not changed since the manifest was built.

nodes.name: JavaLanguageID
nodes.summary: Maps a file name to the Java LSP language ID.

nodes.name: Provider
nodes.summary: Describes the Java live provider state and availability.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.summary: Language groups the providers of one language, so it can be turned on or off as a whole. The list is closed: adding a language is a code change.

nodes.name: Languages
nodes.summary: Languages returns the supported languages in display order.

nodes.name: LanguageOf
nodes.summary: LanguageOf returns the language a provider belongs to.

nodes.name: LiveProviderIDs
nodes.summary: LiveProviderIDs lists every language server provider, in language order.

nodes.name: ManagedToolNames
nodes.summary: ManagedToolNames lists every tool a language can download, in language order.

nodes.name: NewDisabledLanguages
nodes.summary: NewDisabledLanguages ignores IDs that name no language.

nodes.name: Without
nodes.summary: Without drops the registrations of providers whose language is off.

nodes.name: DisabledRegistrations
nodes.summary: DisabledRegistrations reports, for each language that is off and has sources in the project, every provider of that language as disabled.

nodes.name: LiveRegistration
nodes.summary: LiveRegistration is metadata from a concrete adapter, not an execution adapter. Available servers join the same exact attachment-wide proposal as saved checkers.

nodes.name: LiveWorkspace
nodes.summary: LiveWorkspace keeps a server rooted in one contained project directory while approval and attachment authority remain with the parent AuthorizedRoot.

nodes.name: LiveEnvironment
nodes.summary: LiveEnvironment contains reviewed host-local paths only. Discovery does not search parents, private editor caches, install tools, or evaluate project code.

nodes.name: LocalLiveEnvironment
nodes.summary: LocalLiveEnvironment is the production local route's reviewed host metadata.

nodes.name: DiscoverLive
nodes.summary: DiscoverLive supplies production adapter metadata without activating a route. Invalid host metadata/root fails closed; missing/unsupported tools remain independent registrations.

nodes.name: DiscoverLocalLive
nodes.summary: DiscoverLocalLive is the production local live route's discovery: gopls, vtsls (CD-23), the Svelte language server (CD-24), Ruff and Pyright for Python, rust-analyzer, RuboCop and ruby-lsp for Ruby, JDT LS for Java, and

nodes.name: DiscoveryDocuments
nodes.summary: DiscoveryDocuments binds all available checker and live identities, not just the selected server. Trust deliberately still stores one exact fingerprint per project.

nodes.name: validateLive
nodes.summary: Validates a live registration's server and documents configuration.

nodes.name: live_owner.go
nodes.summary: LiveDocuments owns the host-local live route: registers approved servers per project, ensures sessions, delegates document and navigation operations, forwards watched-file changes and propagates session failures.

nodes.name: live_results.go
nodes.summary: Normalizes live LSP diagnostics against document state and selects a bounded, sorted prefix of results using encoded JSON sizes.

nodes.name: live_status.go
nodes.summary: Manager hooks that record bounded adapter notices and session failures for live providers without exposing raw server output.

nodes.name: lsp_documents.go
nodes.summary: SessionDocuments adapts already-running SessionManager sessions to the DocumentProvider seam: resolves owners per path, tracks wire versions per lifecycle, reindexes drafts and forwards didChangeWatchedFiles.
nodes.languageNotes: Positions use UTF-16 code units per LSP, so byte offsets are converted carefully around CRLF and non-BMP runes.

nodes.name: LiveDocuments
nodes.summary: LiveDocuments owns the internal, host-local route. Installing it is not feature negotiation: callers must still keep live capability advertisement disabled.

nodes.name: NewLiveDocuments
nodes.summary: Creates the live route owner over Trust, Manager and session options.

nodes.name: Register
nodes.summary: Registers a complete approved set of live server registrations for a root.

nodes.name: EnsureSession
nodes.summary: EnsureSession is invoked only after Manager validates approval, containment and displayed text. Attach preflights the current complete grant before every reuse or launch. Failure is not automatically retried.

nodes.name: ValidateDocument
nodes.summary: Delegates displayed-text validation to the project's SessionDocuments.

nodes.name: OwnerSessions
nodes.summary: Returns every owning session for a path in the registered project.

nodes.name: OwnerSession
nodes.summary: Returns the single owning session for a path in the registered project.

nodes.name: PublicationVersionFor
nodes.summary: Maps a provider's wire version to the document version for a path.

nodes.name: Apply
nodes.summary: Applies a document step through the owning project's SessionDocuments.

nodes.name: Navigate
nodes.summary: Navigate asks the project's running session; it never starts one.

nodes.name: WatchedFiles
nodes.summary: WatchedFiles notifies running reviewed servers of matching saved-file transitions observed by the approved project watcher. Other paths and projects without a running session are ignored.

nodes.name: Refresh
nodes.summary: Refresh propagates terminal failures without keeping raw server error text. Called by the Engine event pump and before snapshots, not the serve goroutine.

nodes.name: Idle
nodes.summary: Idle is attachment-level: only attachments with no displayed documents may enter grace. One document closing must not idle peers sharing its server.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Adds a diagnostic to the bounded sorted selection respecting manager limits.

nodes.name: normalizeLiveDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Validates and binds a live diagnostic to the document's ID, version and text.

nodes.name: LiveNotice
nodes.summary: LiveNotice accepts only adapter-owned, path-free bounded notices. It never treats a malformed or rejected publication as an empty successful replacement.

nodes.name: LiveFailure
nodes.summary: LiveFailure marks a provider's failed session. cause is the session's bounded error (fixed text, never server output); others read as unavailable.

nodes.name: DocumentServer
nodes.summary: DocumentServer is the fixed, adapter-owned choice of server and language for one project file. It is never decoded from a request.

nodes.name: SessionDocuments
nodes.summary: SessionDocuments adapts approved, already-running SessionManager sessions to DocumentProvider.

nodes.name: runningSession
nodes.summary: runningSession returns the already-running, current session for one exact configuration. It starts nothing and says nothing about document ownership.

nodes.name: serverFor
nodes.summary: Finds the server and running session for a path and exact owner identity.

nodes.name: ValidateDocument
nodes.summary: ValidateDocument checks the displayed text and the saved header against the approved context that owns path. A zero owner checks every resolved owner. It starts nothing and never selects another context.

nodes.name: OwnerSessions
nodes.summary: Reports every owning session (generation, capabilities, error) for a path.

nodes.name: OwnerSession
nodes.summary: OwnerSession preserves the resolver's concrete provider and exact policy.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Session reports the current generation and negotiated capabilities.

nodes.name: recordPublicationURILocked
nodes.summary: recordPublicationURILocked reports whether this is the URI's first recorded open. Once the history is full nothing is first: certification of later opens rests on wire versions alone.

nodes.name: reindex
nodes.summary: Reindex for each open document changed since its last one, in URI order, and discards the answers. It runs before a navigation request on the same transport, so the server sees the drafts first.

nodes.name: PublicationVersionFor
nodes.summary: PublicationVersionFor maps a versioned publication for path to the document version of its open lifecycle on the current transport.

nodes.name: PublicationIsolated
nodes.summary: PublicationIsolated proves that exactly one open was attempted for this wire URI on the current transport. Matching versions cannot provide this proof.

nodes.name: PublicationIsolatedFor
nodes.summary: Provider-specific variant of PublicationIsolated.

nodes.name: watchedFiles
nodes.summary: watchedFiles is WatchedFiles for the servers accept allows (all when nil).

nodes.name: Apply
nodes.summary: Apply sends one ordered notification. Transport failures are reported as bounded errors, so a dropped change is never acknowledged.

nodes.name: lsp_frame.go
nodes.summary: Content-Length framing for LSP over stdio: bounded incremental frame reading, header parsing and full-write encoding.

nodes.name: lsp_navigation.go
nodes.summary: LSP navigation support: request/result types, Manager routing to the best owning session, and parsing of Location/LocationLink and hover answers with root containment and size bounds.

nodes.name: lsp_session.go
nodes.summary: SessionManager and lspSession: lifecycle of host-local language server processes per root and config, including gated launch, initialize handshake, capability negotiation, request policy, idle grace, capacity eviction, retries and crash reports.

nodes.name: lsp_transport.go
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC transport over one LSP stdio stream pair with bounded queues, request/response correlation, cancellation, sanitized stderr capture and explicit failure status.

nodes.name: readFrame
nodes.summary: ErrUnexpectedEOF.

nodes.name: readHeaderLine
nodes.summary: readHeaderLine reads one CRLF-terminated line, never buffering more than budget bytes.

nodes.name: parseLength
nodes.summary: Parses a Content-Length header value.

nodes.name: NavigationLocation
nodes.summary: NavigationLocation is one place an answer points to. Path is project relative (slash separated) inside the root; outside it, Path is the absolute host path and External is set. Ranges are UTF-16, exclusive end.

nodes.name: HoverText
nodes.summary: HoverText is the server's description of the symbol at a position.

nodes.name: NavigationResult
nodes.summary: NavigationResult answers one request for the document at Version. Locations is empty, never nil, when the server knows no place; Hover is nil when it has nothing to say. Truncated reports dropped locations or hover text.

nodes.name: NavigationRequest
nodes.summary: NavigationRequest is one request to the session that holds the document at Generation, resolved by the Manager under its lock.

nodes.name: NavigationProvider
nodes.summary: NavigationProvider sends navigation requests to running sessions. Like DocumentProvider it never starts a process.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Validate checks an answer that crossed a connection against the bounds Navigate keeps, so a peer cannot hand the editor more, or other, than a local server would.

nodes.name: externalPath
nodes.summary: externalPath accepts an absolute path of either host family (the peer may run another OS) without parent steps.

nodes.name: Navigate
nodes.summary: Navigate asks the language server that holds an open document about the symbol at pos. The document must be open at exactly version, so the position means what the server has.

nodes.name: navigationRoute
nodes.summary: navigationRoute picks the session that answers op for the document. Of several owners (Pyright and Ruff share Python files), the one offering the most navigation answers: a language server rather than a linter.

nodes.name: navigationCallError
nodes.summary: Maps navigation transport errors to bounded client errors.

nodes.name: locationResult
nodes.summary: locationResult reads Location, Location[] or LocationLink[]. A link's target selection range (the name) is used, else its target range.

nodes.name: navigationPath
nodes.summary: navigationPath maps a file URI to a project path, or to an absolute path marked external when it lies outside the root. A path under the root that does not resolve inside it (missing, or a link leading out) is dropped.

nodes.name: hoverResult
nodes.summary: hoverResult reads MarkupContent, a MarkedString or an array of them. Marked strings are Markdown; a language-tagged one becomes a fenced code block.

nodes.name: ServerConfig
nodes.summary: ServerConfig is the fixed, adapter-owned identity of one installed server. Executable and argv are used exactly. Nothing here is client-decoded.

nodes.name: ServerCapabilities
nodes.summary: ServerCapabilities is the negotiated subset recorded for document operations.

nodes.name: SessionInfo
nodes.summary: SessionInfo is a bounded snapshot with no document text or raw frames.

nodes.name: SessionStreams
nodes.summary: SessionStreams are the stdio ends of one launched server.

nodes.name: SessionProcess
nodes.summary: SessionProcess is one launched server. Terminate must kill the whole process tree; Close releases handles. Wait must return after Terminate and Close.

nodes.name: SessionOptions
nodes.summary: SessionOptions configures a manager. Zero values take the proposed defaults; limits can only be narrowed. After supplies every deadline and grace timer.

nodes.name: SessionFailure
nodes.summary: SessionFailure is the local crash report of one failed session. It carries sanitized, bounded server stderr, so it is for the owner's on-disk log only and must never reach a snapshot, event or the UI.

nodes.name: SessionNotification
nodes.summary: SessionNotification is one bounded server publication. Params is the raw, transport-bounded JSON; it is never logged or retained by the session.

nodes.name: SessionManager
nodes.summary: SessionManager owns host-local LSP sessions for one connection/app lifetime. Authorization and approval come from CD-02 (AuthorizedRoot, Trust); it never grants either.

nodes.name: OwnedResources
nodes.summary: OwnedResources is a bounded snapshot of live goroutines owned by one manager.

nodes.name: lspSession
nodes.summary: lspSession is one generation of one server.

nodes.name: command
nodes.summary: Builds the exact process Command from a fixed ServerConfig.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.summary: Tools is the server's complete approval contribution: its own identity plus any bound toolchain files.

nodes.name: scopedToolID
nodes.summary: Keep semantic provider identities separate from exact proposal identities. Hash both components so even a 256-byte toolchain ID stays bounded.

nodes.name: defaults
nodes.summary: Fills zero SessionOptions with defaults and narrows limits.

nodes.name: waitProcess
nodes.summary: waitProcess starts the single process waiter for s.

nodes.name: Attach
nodes.summary: Attach returns the single reusable initialized session for this root and server, starting it if needed. Concurrent attaches share one start. A session inside its idle grace is resumed and its timer canceled.

nodes.name: attach
nodes.summary: Starts or reuses a session for root and config after a lease preflight, sharing concurrent starts and evicting idle sessions at capacity.

nodes.name: gate
nodes.summary: gate enforces the fixed executable/argv contract before anything can start.

nodes.name: capacityVictimLocked
nodes.summary: capacityVictimLocked returns the oldest idle session of another project when the cap is reached. Visible (non-idle) projects are never evicted.

nodes.name: Hide
nodes.summary: Hide starts the idle grace. The grace timer comes from After so tests drive it.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Stops every session gracefully (shutdown/exit under deadline) on app shutdown.

nodes.name: stopWhere
nodes.summary: Stops every session matching a key predicate.

nodes.name: Retry
nodes.summary: Retry starts a fresh generation after failure or disconnect, at most MaxRestarts times per server. The failed generation is already invalid and can never publish again.

nodes.name: Info
nodes.summary: Info reports the current generation, or a stopped placeholder.

nodes.name: CurrentGeneration
nodes.summary: CurrentGeneration reports whether results tagged with generation may still be published: false for any invalidated, replaced or stopped generation.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: current is false once the generation is invalidated or trust is revoked.

nodes.name: info
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded SessionInfo snapshot.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Session goroutine: initializes the server, marks it ready and serves until stopped.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Performs the LSP initialize/initialized handshake and negotiates capabilities.

nodes.name: initializeParams
nodes.summary: initializeParams advertises only what this client implements: the UTF-16 position encoding, plus workspace/configuration when the adapter supplies fixed settings and publishDiagnostics (no versionSupport) when it declare

nodes.name: serve
nodes.summary: serve applies the request policy until the transport or generation ends. Anything arriving for an invalid generation is drained and dropped.

nodes.name: handleRequest
nodes.summary: handleRequest serves the same fixed policy during startup and normal operation. It must never call notification callbacks or the document manager.

nodes.name: onlyWatcherRegistrations
nodes.summary: onlyWatcherRegistrations reports a bounded registration request made only of didChangeWatchedFiles entries; anything else is still rejected.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: stop invalidates the generation BEFORE any cleanup, then shuts the server down.

nodes.name: drainCrash
nodes.summary: drainCrash waits up to crashDrainTimeout for a failed server to be reaped and its stderr to reach EOF. The transport already killed the tree on failure; closing the pipes now could drop the end of a crash stack.

nodes.name: boundedFailure
nodes.summary: boundedFailure maps internal errors to bounded CD-01 errors with no server text.

nodes.name: negotiateCapabilities
nodes.summary: negotiateCapabilities accepts only what the client implements: UTF-16 positions and full/incremental open/close synchronization. Anything else fails the session rather than letting later ranges or versions be misread.

nodes.name: boundedConfiguration
nodes.summary: boundedConfiguration answers workspace/configuration from the adapter's fixed settings only: the empty section is the whole object, a dotted section is the nested value, anything absent is null.

nodes.name: insideRoot
nodes.summary: insideRoot is a lexical, metadata-free containment check on file URIs.

nodes.name: LSPLimits
nodes.summary: LSPLimits bounds every resource the transport can consume. Zero fields take defaults. These are separate from the app RPC frame limit.

nodes.name: LSPMessage
nodes.summary: LSPMessage is an inbound notification or server request.

nodes.name: LSPResponseError
nodes.summary: LSPResponseError is a JSON-RPC error answer from the server. Message is sanitized and truncated.

nodes.name: LSPStatus
nodes.summary: LSPStatus is a bounded snapshot for the manager. Overflow and protocol failure are visible here and in Err; nothing is dropped silently.

nodes.name: LSPTransport
nodes.summary: LSPTransport owns one stdio stream pair. Identity is carried so the manager can invalidate a dead stream's attachment/generation.

nodes.name: withDefaults
nodes.summary: Fills zero LSPLimits fields with defaults.

nodes.name: NewLSPTransport
nodes.summary: NewLSPTransport starts reader/writer goroutines. closer must unblock reads on stdout and writes on stdin (typically closing the process pipes); it is closed on failure or Close. stderr may be nil.

nodes.name: Err
nodes.summary: Err returns the first failure (ErrLSPClosed after a plain Close), or nil.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.summary: Status returns a bounded snapshot.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Close fails pending work with ErrLSPClosed, closes the streams and waits for all transport goroutines.

nodes.name: fail
nodes.summary: Records the first transport failure, fails pending calls and closes streams.

nodes.name: call
nodes.summary: call optionally serves incoming messages while awaiting the response. Only the session's initialize handshake uses this: its normal Incoming consumer has not started yet.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.summary: Notify sends a notification. It returns once the frame is fully written, ctx ends, or the transport fails.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.summary: Respond answers a server request with a result.

nodes.name: respond
nodes.summary: Encodes and sends a response to a server request.

nodes.name: writeLoop
nodes.summary: Writer goroutine draining the outgoing frame queue.

nodes.name: readLoop
nodes.summary: Reader goroutine reading frames and dispatching them.

nodes.name: dispatch
nodes.summary: Decodes one inbound JSON-RPC message, completing waiters or queuing notifications and requests.

nodes.name: stderrLoop
nodes.summary: stderrLoop drains stderr (so the server never blocks on it) keeping only a bounded sanitized prefix and tail. It is entirely separate from stdout framing.

nodes.name: manager.go
nodes.summary: Core diagnostics Manager owning one authenticated connection: attachments, discovery metadata, approval, setup/preparation, coalesced checker runs, cancellation, path deletion and pulled event delivery.

nodes.name: manager_events.go
nodes.summary: Builds bounded snapshot recovery events after a drain overflow, splitting findings into events by encoded JSON size.

nodes.name: manager_identity.go
nodes.summary: Reserved document identity publication guard that strictly matches context, path and saved basis versions.

nodes.name: attachment
nodes.summary: Per-attachment state: snapshot, adapters, tools, runs, events, live documents, external grants and preparation.

nodes.name: Manager
nodes.summary: Manager owns one authenticated connection and its Supervisor and Trust. Close (also the disconnect hook) invalidates ownership before joining process cleanup.

nodes.name: NewManager
nodes.summary: Creates a Manager for a connection with Trust, Supervisor and limits.

nodes.name: Attach
nodes.summary: Attach accepts only a previously catalog-authorized root and backend-owned registrations. There is no probing, process execution or client command input.

nodes.name: CompleteDiscoveryWithPublication
nodes.summary: CompleteDiscoveryWithPublication installs live discovery atomically with its manager metadata. publish must not call back into Manager or execute tools.

nodes.name: prepareMetadata
nodes.summary: Validates registrations and builds a new attachment with adapters, tools and the initial snapshot.

nodes.name: GetSnapshot
nodes.summary: Returns the current snapshot of an attachment.

nodes.name: Approve
nodes.summary: Approves an attachment's proposal through Trust and updates its snapshot.

nodes.name: StartPreparation
nodes.summary: StartPreparation owns setup and rediscovery. discover is metadata-only. publish installs validated live metadata under the manager lock and must not call back into Manager.

nodes.name: prepareApproved
nodes.summary: Runs approved setup plans under a lease.

nodes.name: finishPreparation
nodes.summary: Finishes setup by rediscovery, rebinding the grant and installing new registrations.

nodes.name: preparationCovered
nodes.summary: Checks whether new tools differ from the old only by planned setup outputs.

nodes.name: Revoke
nodes.summary: Revokes an attachment's approval, cancels work and clears results.

nodes.name: Detach
nodes.summary: Detaches an attachment and releases its documents and runs.

nodes.name: Close
nodes.summary: Invalidates ownership and closes all attachments on disconnect.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Run coalesces current work. supersede is a backend policy flag, not an argv escape hatch. A bounded number of adapter goroutines may exist, including canceled work still cleaning up.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs one checker adapter under a lease and commits its result if current.

nodes.name: Cancel
nodes.summary: Cancels the identified runs.

nodes.name: DeletePath
nodes.summary: DeletePath cancels all current work before clearing a deleted path. Thus an adapter already reading that file cannot resurrect it; no tombstone set grows.

nodes.name: DrainEvents
nodes.summary: DrainEvents transfers at most two complete updates. resnapshot is explicit after overflow: consumers must discard assembly and GetSnapshot, not apply a sequence gap as an empty replacement.

nodes.name: commit
nodes.summary: Commits snapshot changes as a queued event update.

nodes.name: SnapshotEvents
nodes.summary: SnapshotEvents builds bounded recovery events after a drain overflow. It does not increment sequence or retain another copy in the delivery queue.

nodes.name: eventParts
nodes.summary: eventParts uses encoded sizes, including Go's HTML/control escaping. A 1024 byte reserve covers the RPC notification wrapper (CD-09 must verify its own exact envelope).

nodes.name: DocumentIdentity
nodes.summary: DocumentIdentity reserves the v1 publication guard for Stage 2. It owns no document text, session, watcher or execution; Stage 1 never accepts LSP sets.

nodes.name: update_windows.go
nodes.summary: Windows build hooks that wire the desktop app's self-update callbacks to the MSI-based updater, detecting once whether the running install can replace itself.

nodes.name: windowsInstall
nodes.summary: Determines once, via Windows Installer, whether the running app can update itself through its MSI, returning the updater descriptor or nil.

nodes.name: window_ring.go
nodes.summary: Cross-process window ring: each open window registers a locked win-<id>.json marker so the window-cycling shortcut can focus the next or previous app window, pruning entries of dead windows.

nodes.name: joinRing
nodes.summary: Adds this window to the cross-process ring by taking a lock and writing its marker file.

nodes.name: leaveRingLocked
nodes.summary: Removes this window's ring marker and releases its lock.

nodes.name: ringMembers
nodes.summary: Lists open ring windows in join order, removing entries of windows that exited without leaving.

nodes.name: ringAlive
nodes.summary: Checks whether a ring entry's window still holds its lock, deleting stale entries.

nodes.name: focusNextWindow
nodes.summary: Focuses the next or previous window in the ring, doing nothing when alone.

nodes.name: windows.go
nodes.summary: Registry of the desktop app's open windows in one process, giving each window its own App instance and routing frontend calls by window name, with close guards and orderly shutdown.

nodes.name: NewWindows
nodes.summary: Creates the window registry with a shared notification hub and open/quit callbacks.

nodes.name: Reserve
nodes.summary: Creates an App for a new window and returns its never-reused window name.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Starts a reserved window's App with a per-window context and desktop adapter extended with shared features.

nodes.name: BeforeClose
nodes.summary: Runs the unsaved-files close guard, returning true to keep the window open.

nodes.name: Closed
nodes.summary: Tears down a closed window's App, stopping its calls at once and finishing cleanup in the background.

nodes.name: FocusNextWindow
nodes.summary: Brings the next app window to the front through the cross-process ring.

nodes.name: Shutdown
nodes.summary: Closes every remaining window App at quit and waits for pending teardowns.

nodes.name: detach
nodes.summary: Stops a window's calls and events, forgets it, and returns the deferred release of its resources.

nodes.name: app
nodes.summary: Returns the started App for a window name, waiting until it has started.

nodes.name: Windows
nodes.summary: Per-process registry of open windows, each with an isolated App (engine, connection, terminals) addressed by window name.

nodes.name: windowEntry
nodes.summary: Internal record of one window's App, context, start and close state.

nodes.name: windowstate.go
nodes.summary: Persists and restores window geometry in window-state.json beside config.toml, with first-run defaults, cascading for new windows and clamping to the screen work area.

nodes.name: WindowStatePath
nodes.summary: Returns the path of window-state.json in the user's config directory.

nodes.name: LoadWindowStates
nodes.summary: Reads remembered geometries per role, treating missing or malformed data as no state.

nodes.name: SaveWindowState
nodes.summary: Saves one role's geometry under the config lock while keeping the other role's state.

nodes.name: MaximiseBeforeShow
nodes.summary: Decides whether a maximised window must be created maximised, which only GTK on Wayland requires.

nodes.name: gdkUsesWayland
nodes.summary: Detects whether GDK will pick its Wayland backend from GDK_BACKEND or the Wayland display.

nodes.name: DefaultWindowState
nodes.summary: Computes the first-run window size, capped to 90% of the work area and centered.

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.summary: Offsets a geometry diagonally so new windows do not cover their opener.

nodes.name: ClampToWorkArea
nodes.summary: Moves and shrinks a geometry so the window opens fully inside the work area.

nodes.name: VisibleEnough
nodes.summary: Checks that the title bar and a usable corner of the window lie in the work area.

nodes.name: clampInt
nodes.summary: Clamps an integer to a range, tolerating an inverted range.

nodes.name: WindowState
nodes.summary: Remembered window geometry: normal bounds in CSS pixels and maximised flag.

nodes.name: Area
nodes.summary: Rectangle in CSS pixels describing a screen work area.

nodes.name: configfile.go
nodes.summary: Lock-protected, atomic, line-preserving editor for the shared config.toml so concurrent writers of different tables and keys keep each other's changes and comments.

nodes.name: Lock
nodes.summary: Takes the shared path+".lock" file lock with a bounded wait.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Read-modify-writes the config file under its lock and writes the result atomically.

nodes.name: sweepStaleTemps
nodes.summary: Deletes stale config-*.tmp files left by killed writes.

nodes.name: WriteAtomic
nodes.summary: Replaces a file via a synced 0600 temp file and rename in a 0700 directory.

nodes.name: Value
nodes.summary: Reads a key's string value from a TOML table, stripping quotes and trailing comments.

nodes.name: parseValue
nodes.summary: Unquotes a TOML value and removes a trailing comment.

nodes.name: SetValue
nodes.summary: Sets a key in a TOML table in place, appending to the table or adding the table, keeping all other lines.

nodes.name: filelock.go
nodes.summary: Platform-neutral part of the file lock package: a bounded-wait Acquire built on the platform TryLock.

nodes.name: Acquire
nodes.summary: Retries TryLock until a timeout so a stalled holder cannot block forever.

nodes.name: filelock_unix.go
nodes.summary: Unix implementation of the exclusive advisory file lock using flock, refusing symlinks and creating lock files 0600.

nodes.name: TryLock
nodes.summary: Non-blocking flock on a 0600 lock file, refusing symlinks and returning ErrLocked when held.

nodes.name: Unlock
nodes.summary: Releases the flock lock; safe on nil and repeated calls.

nodes.name: Lock
nodes.summary: Exclusive advisory flock on one file.

nodes.name: filelock_windows.go
nodes.summary: Windows implementation of the exclusive file lock using LockFileEx, refusing symlinks.

nodes.name: TryLock
nodes.summary: Non-blocking LockFileEx lock, refusing symlinks and returning ErrLocked when held.

nodes.name: Unlock
nodes.summary: Releases the LockFileEx lock; safe on nil and repeated calls.

nodes.name: Lock
nodes.summary: Exclusive LockFileEx lock on one file.

nodes.name: translate.go
nodes.summary: Client for translating transcript messages through an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, with config validation, prompt-injection-aware selection translation and redacted error reporting.

nodes.name: Configured
nodes.summary: Reports whether base URL, API key and model are all set.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Rejects config values containing characters that would not round-trip through quoted storage.

nodes.name: NewClient
nodes.summary: Creates a proxy-aware HTTP client with a two-minute timeout.

nodes.name: SystemPrompt
nodes.summary: Builds the system instruction sent with every translation request.

nodes.name: Translate
nodes.summary: Translates a whole message into the configured language.

nodes.name: TranslateSelection
nodes.summary: Translates a selected span using surrounding text only for context, treating both as untrusted.

nodes.name: validateInput
nodes.summary: Checks configuration and input size before a request.

nodes.name: complete
nodes.summary: Shared chat-completions transport: sends the request, decodes the reply and maps errors.

nodes.name: statusError
nodes.summary: Formats a failed reply from its status and provider error message, redacting secrets.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Translation settings: endpoint, API key, model and target language.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapper that sends translation requests.

nodes.name: recordApply

nodes.summary: Copies the running bundle to the updates folder and starts it as the apply helper for after exit.

nodes.summary: Starts the helper with a notify pipe on fd 3 and waits for it to report in.

nodes.name: copyTree
nodes.summary: Recursively copies a directory preserving permissions and symlinks.

nodes.name: copyFile
nodes.summary: Copies one regular file with the given permissions.

nodes.summary: Helper body: builds the Swap for the staged bundle, runs it under the store lock and records the outcome.

nodes.name: waitExit
nodes.summary: Polls until a process id no longer exists or the context ends.

nodes.summary: Two-step uninstall-then-install MSI update with verification and rollback.
